subject: New district maps are coming in New York
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

New congressional maps are coming in New York state before this June’s
primary, and they could impact Rep. Jamaal Bowman’s Democratic primary
fight against a GOP-backed moderate challenger in NY-16.

The maps are getting close to being locked in this week, and AIPAC is
coming with everything they have to unseat Jamaal. They’ve already raised
$600,000 for his opponent’s campaign, including tens of thousands from
Republican donors, and they’re successfully convincing some Republican
voters to switch parties just so they can vote against Jamaal.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240228-2-jb.ibpfgb&refcode=em20240228-33555&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1001&akid=33555%2E1203867%2EvH20fw ]It’s go time: split a grassroots donation between Justice Democrats and
Jamaal’s campaign NOW to ensure we have the resources to fight back and
keep a true progressive Democrat in this seat →

Jamaal’s opponent is a white, career politician who’s using GOP money to
run against the first Black Congressmember to represent this district —
and he’s insulting Black Democratic voters along the way.

A new HuffPost article notes how George Latimer chose to highlight the
accomplishments of Black elected officials at an event last month, while
completely failing to mention Jamaal. One attendee said, “I can’t believe
that he doesn’t know what he’s doing when he’s trying to surgically remove
representation — not just somebody who looks like me and shares my gender,
but someone who represents my issues in a way that very few other elected
officials do.”

Every day, we're reminded how powerful career politicians like Latimer
are. Our system lets Super PACs, lobby groups, and corporate allies like
AIPAC prop them up, while they divide and dilute the voices of Black,
brown, poor, and working-class communities they’re vying to represent.

Now is the time to fight back.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240228-2-jb.ibpfgb&refcode=em20240228-33555&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1002&akid=33555%2E1203867%2EvH20fw ]We can’t afford to lose Jamaal’s critical representation, leadership,
and moral clarity in Congress this June. Please, chip in whatever you can
to support Justice Democrats and Jamaal before tomorrow’s February
deadline.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240228-2-jb.ibpfgb&refcode=em20240228-33555&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1021&akid=33555%2E1203867%2EvH20fw ]Contribute $3

— Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time.

There are other ways to make an impact in support of peace and equality in
Israel and Palestine: please urge your member of Congress to support a
ceasefire through [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139873?t=1022&akid=33555%2E1203867%2EvH20fw ]Adalah Justice Project’s petition or by calling them
using [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139874?t=1023&akid=33555%2E1203867%2EvH20fw ]Jewish Voice for Peace’s dialer here. Your voice matters in this
critical moment.

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20240228-33555-footer&t=1024&refcode2=33555_1203867_vH20fw&akid=33555%2E1203867%2EvH20fw

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://go.justicedemocrats.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1025&akid=33555%2E1203867%2EvH20fw

Friends — We just launched our plan to get to fair maps in 2032, and I'll admit it's hard to fully wrap your head around the timeframe. Ten years is a long time in politics. But A.G. Holder often reminds us to think about Dr. King’s famous quote, _“The arc of the moral universe is long, but it bends towards justice.”_ A.G. Holder often reminds us to think about how the arc of the moral universe doesn’t bend all by itself. It bends because caring, committed people put their hands on that arc and pull it in the right direction. It bends under the relentless pounding of marching feet. It bends because people like you — people like us — are determined to bend it together. I believe that with all my heart. This plan is about us pulling that arc towards justice and not waiting for it to bend on its own. Our 10 Year Plan will **protect** the fair maps we’ve achieved, **prevent** anti-democratic Republican efforts to gerrymander maps and undermine our democracy, and **propel** toward fair redistricting and a more representative democracy. As one of our most valued supporters, you know the movement for fair maps is a long — but worthy — fight. VOTE RYAN MACKENZIE APRIL 23rd | | | | |
---
Friends,
Today was _WFMZ’S Business Matters_ Republican Congressional candidate debate. Two facts became clear: Ryan Mackenzie was the decisive winner and Kevin Dellicker suffered major damage on two key issues important to Republican voters across Pennsylvania’s 7th Congressional District.
The debate will air in two parts on WFMZ. Part 1: Monday, March 18th and Part 2: Monday, March 25th, both at 7:30 P.M.
Here is our press release that was put out recapping the debate:
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASEDATE: February 28, 2024CONTACT: press@mackenzieforcongress.com
**Mackenzie Wins First Republican Debate****Dellicker Does Massive Flip-Flop on Ukraine Funding and Struggles to Answer Question about Trump**
(Allentown, PA) At today’s taping of _WFMZ’S Business Matters_ Republican Congressional candidate debate, two facts became clear: Ryan Mackenzie was the decisive winner and Kevin Dellicker suffered major damage on two key issues important to Republican voters across Pennsylvania’s 7th Congressional District.
Mackenzie was the only candidate who presented a proven record that voters can trust: a record of achieving positive results, winning tough elections, and having a plan that puts America First by protecting taxpayers, fighting illegal immigration, keeping our nation out of forever wars, and protecting conservative values.
“The big difference between me and the other candidates is that voters can see what I have accomplished. From voting against the gas tax, reforming the pension system, fighting illegal immigration, and much more, I have a proven record of getting conservative results,” said Mackenzie. “Voters don’t have to rely on the empty political promises of my opponents, they can see my proven, effective leadership in office.”
Of particular note during the debate was the massive flip-flop by Kevin Dellicker on additional war funding for Ukraine that Mackenzie pointed out. Dellicker has repeatedly stated on the record his support of war funding for Ukraine. But today, for the first time, he backed down and flip-flopped after Mackenzie called him out on his position to fund forever wars.
At the Lehigh Valley Tea Party candidate forum on January 4, 2024, Dellicker said, “When it comes to funding for Ukraine, we need to be able to support the Ukrainian army,” (Source: [https://youtu.be/AkznHxLbMzI](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=8e71f0482f&e=5ccada9200)). At the Slate Belt Republican Association on August 8, 2023, Dellicker said, “I tell you what, I’m glad we are sending them arms,” (Source: [https://youtu.be/4HXbbagCQ9s](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=9cb4386ba9&e=5ccada9200))
On the question of endorsing Trump, Mackenzie stated he was the first and - up until the debate - the only GOP Congressional candidate to endorse Donald Trump for President. Dellicker’s initial answers clearly showed that he had not endorsed Trump and Dellicker resisted doing so until Mackenzie forced him to. At which point, Dellicker begrudgingly said “fine” to endorsing Donald Trump for President.

name: Gene Karpinski, LCV
subject: BREAKING NEWS: The 2023 National Environmental Scorecard is here
body:
Be one of the first to see how your members of Congress scored on the most important issues of 2023, Peter |
---

** **
|
I've got some exciting news Peter,

Today, we released our 2023 _National Environmental Scorecard_ , and I wanted to make sure you saw it first!

Our _Scorecard_ has been the primary yardstick for evaluating the environmental records of members of Congress since 1970, trusted by the media, policymakers, and the public alike. You can [download it by clicking here (PDF)](https://links.messages.lcv.) or go online at [scorecard.lcv.org](https://links.messages.lcv.).

[](https://links.messages.lcv.)
This newest _Scorecard_ shows that in 2023, environmental champions in Congress successfully fought back against relentless and **sweeping attacks on our democracy and environmental protections by a chaotic MAGA Republican-led House,** which took hundreds of symbolic votes to cater to Big Polluters and the most extreme wing of their party. The House-led chaos stands in **stark contrast to 2022 's fruitful legislative climate action and 2023's progress on judicial nominations in the Senate** -- and the consequence was hundreds of missed opportunities to help communities, lower costs, and make progress against the climate crisis.
**_" 2023 was not only the hottest year on record, it was one of the least productive legislative years ever because of MAGA House Republicans' extreme leadership...We appreciate our allies in the House who consistently opposed these attacks and, thanks to champions in the Senate and the president's steadfast leadership, these attempts to undermine the historic affordable clean energy plan were unsuccessful."_
-- LCV Senior Vice President of Government Affairs Tiernan Sittenfeld**
For the second year, this year's _Scorecard_ highlights the leadership of the Tri-Caucus, including the **history-making election of House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries as the first member of the Tri-Caucus elected to lead a party in either chamber.** Leadership of the Congressional Asian Pacific American Caucus, Congressional Black Caucus, and Congressional Hispanic Caucus scored an **average of 99% on the 2023 _Scorecard_.** These champions led and supported many of the forward-looking climate, conservation, environmental justice, and equitable democracy bills and initiatives in Congress last year, in addition to educating constituents and connecting communities to transformational investments within the federal clean energy plan.

The 2023 _Scorecard_ includes a near record-high **36 House votes, 15 of which were extreme, MAGA-led amendments offered to government funding bills that already had no path to enactment.**

In contrast to the House, the Senate remained in Democratic control and passed four bipartisan appropriations bills and confirmed 69 lifetime federal judges. The **Senate 's 16 votes** include confirming judges who are experts in voting rights and environmental issues and rejecting attempts to block protections for our health, environment, workers, and communities, in addition to a failed vote to prevent the forced final approvals of the Mountain Valley Pipeline.

[Check out the 2023 _National Environmental Scorecard_ here, and learn more about how your representatives and others across the country voted on critical issues.](https://links.messages.lcv.)

Thank you, Peter, for your support in holding members of Congress accountable to protect our environment and democracy. We couldn't do this work without you!

Onward,

Friend,

I'm the product of an unplanned pregnancy.

Born to two teenage parents, every statistic and societal roadblock indicated that I was destined for a life of hardship.

But my parents didn't buy into any of that.

I may have been unplanned, but that did not mean I was unwanted.

Soon after me, three more kids came. And what began as a teenage love story quickly became a family of six. My dad went to work and did whatever he needed to do to make ends meet for our family. That meant putting his life on the line to serve his community in the local fire department.

All my life, I wanted to be like my dad, and there was nothing I dreamed of more than becoming a firefighter just like him.

But on a fateful day in September of 1984, all of that changed.

My dad and his battalion responded to a call that would change all of our lives forever.

By the grace of God my dad made it out of that building alive, but not unscathed. Eighty percent of his body was covered in burns.

From then on, the hardest working man that I knew would not be able to work as a fireman another day of his life. And as the oldest of four kids, it was up to me to step in and help fill the void in our young family.

We're all a product of our experiences, and that moment defined who I am.

My dream of becoming a firefighter like my dad was now discouraged, and I had effectively been launched into the role of a pseudo-parent to my younger siblings overnight.

**Being raised in a Christian household without a lot of means, we put our head down for two reasons:

1\. To pray to God
2\. To get to work**

So, at 12 years old, I picked myself up by my bootstraps and did just that -- got to work.

And to be quite honest, I haven't really picked my head back up since.

>From a young boy trying to help his parents make ends meet, to a law student, to a husband and father, and eventually to Speaker of the House, the only thing I have ever been focused on is getting the job done.

My wife might call me a workaholic, but in my mind, I am a man who is focused on the task at hand, and completing a mission.

**[Right now, my mission is to ensure that my kids have the same opportunity to make a life for themselves and achieve their goals like I did.](http://links.primaryupdate.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=ee6956bf3d2d4097b0a5dcc0e8da6046&_e=LP-95-6MDWQnWnuDJq8PgfNeSE8z3nqHLl29lbFvJgV5SBq-9ALcAPLFcSQ8pMrJH6p7ivrwq229tnd7ehOE86rTLMx6reo1tFXEk1AgAlFmOVQZUHW7q2KHo58T3rENTUHahHXw4no1Xy6JOowyJY5Si3CXuV7q0PxXCNEJYRQ6oqZj61ggXI2cP9hxZyMMeDX0eBmx1TiOYxRl-Kk8jAQIxUWIzXN6PdCj0saf21cleaPxyIg0ADnpKkiDOH9Skr0N8knY5vzVEYY_XJa4-wzEv1dTILWJX1GsGHtIdml_phQtqaXuJoh7ac5IWFV61YaWWnQMLNzAl_dlTDdaZGRVzAbMdeQ-krbpOwM2WDLrW9sdbZKyVMyC_8_QGZQGIJhrpyFIoBBltn4GELUSxo-ciVZLJvdP8A5iReo9MCnOBp_pPVvADm5UN1a071A4sX1cL8LHLKzkC1uA4iNyo61tWKHU_Ie7bD9IQ_pfOVZodcU3LqhmHyJ2RIAM2RugGpTPKz_Iy7ulNWnwzj5CIQ%3D%3D "Right now, my mission is to ensure that my kids have the same opportunity to make a life for themselves and achieve their goals like I did. ")**

And that means being the kind of conservative, Christian leader in Washington, D.C. that my dad would be proud of.

That alone puts you at odds with the D.C. Establishment, by the way.

I'm not interested in the cocktail parties, or rubbing elbows with different special interest groups.

The Washington Elite and their allies in the mainstream media can cast judgment all they want. That doesn't bother me.

Because at the end of the day, I know that I serve an audience of one -- and that I am doing all that I can with the blessings given to me, and the faith entrusted to me, to glorify God.

**[So, now that you know just a little bit more about me, where I come from, and what keeps me going, I humbly ask if you are willing to stand alongside me in this fight?](http://links.primaryupdate.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=ee6956bf3d2d4097b0a5dcc0e8da6046&_e=LP-95-6MDWQnWnuDJq8PgfNeSE8z3nqHLl29lbFvJgV5SBq-9ALcAPLFcSQ8pMrJH6p7ivrwq229tnd7ehOE86rTLMx6reo1tFXEk1AgAlFmOVQZUHW7q2KHo58T3rENTUHahHXw4no1Xy6JOowyJY5Si3CXuV7q0PxXCNEJYRQ6oqZj61ggXI2cP9hxZyMMeDX0eBmx1TiOYxRl-Kk8jAQIxUWIzXN6PdCj0saf21cleaPxyIg0ADnpKkiDOH9Skr0N8knY5vzVEYY_XJa4-wzEv1dTILWJX1GsGHtIdml_phQtqaXuJoh7ac5IWFV61YaWWnQMLNzAl_dlTDdaZGRVzAbMdeQ-krbpOwM2WDLrW9sdbZKyVMyC_8_QGZQGMAhjrQgkH65DtWglkDoIRXtteyk9zv2IOuHh8vSigJ2_7th1KaVImH3kLGiGNpp7OHm1bUVlSnLf4eY72RpGkc0WZG4RmFSjTrMlAYwYlXaIQ-lvkoKulhgspKUkjEY-aUQ2m1T4aPFL4sMUuct6AQ%3D%3D "So, now that you know just a little bit more about me, where I come from, and what keeps me going, I humbly ask if you are willing to stand alongside me in this fight? clean_body: I serve God first | | | | | | Friend, I'm the product of an unplanned pregnancy. Born to two teenage parents, every statistic and societal roadblock indicated that I was destined for a life of hardship. But my parents didn't buy into any of that. I may have been unplanned, but that did not mean I was unwanted. Soon after me, three more kids came. And what began as a teenage love story quickly became a family of six. My dad went to work and did whatever he needed to do to make ends meet for our family. That meant putting his life on the line to serve his community in the local fire department. All my life, I wanted to be like my dad, and there was nothing I dreamed of more than becoming a firefighter just like him. But on a fateful day in September of 1984, all of that changed. My dad and his battalion responded to a call that would change all of our lives forever. By the grace of God my dad made it out of that building alive, but not unscathed. Eighty percent of his body was covered in burns. From then on, the hardest working man that I knew would not be able to work as a fireman another day of his life. And as the oldest of four kids, it was up to me to step in and help fill the void in our young family. We're all a product of our experiences, and that moment defined who I am. My dream of becoming a firefighter like my dad was now discouraged, and I had effectively been launched into the role of a pseudo-parent to my younger siblings overnight. Being raised in a Christian household without a lot of means, we put our head down for two reasons: 1\. To pray to God 2\. To get to work So, at 12 years old, I picked myself up by my bootstraps and did just that -- got to work. And to be quite honest, I haven't really picked my head back up since. From a young boy trying to help his parents make ends meet, to a law student, to a husband and father, and eventually to Speaker of the House, the only thing I have ever been focused on is getting the job done. My wife might call me a workaholic, but in my mind, I am a man who is focused on the task at hand, and completing a mission. "Right now, my mission is to ensure that my kids have the same opportunity to make a life for themselves and achieve their goals like I did. " And that means being the kind of conservative, Christian leader in Washington, D.C. that my dad would be proud of. That alone puts you at odds with the D.C. Establishment, by the way. I'm not interested in the cocktail parties, or rubbing elbows with different special interest groups. The Washington Elite and their allies in the mainstream media can cast judgment all they want. That doesn't bother me. Because at the end of the day, I know that I serve an audience of one -- and that I am doing all that I can with the blessings given to me, and the faith entrusted to me, to glorify God. "So, now that you know just a little bit more about me, where I come from, and what keeps me going, I humbly ask if you are willing to stand alongside me in this fight? " | | I'm not going to lie to you, it won't be easy. But doing what's right rarely is. Thank you for your time and support, | Speaker Mike Johnson * | | | Paid for by Mike Johnson for Louisiana P.O. name: Jocelyn Benson
subject: Inspiring
disclaimer_text:
Paid for by
Jocelyn Benson for Secretary of State
body:
Friends,

If I could describe yesterday in one word, I’d say it was “inspiring.”

I spent Election Day visiting poll workers and voters around the state. The hard work and dedication I saw from everyone tasked with protecting our election was consistently impressive. After our work in 2020 and 2022, you know as well as I do that our expectations for elections in Michigan are very high – from voters being educated about their options, to poll workers and clerks being accountable and transparent.

This primary election met and exceeded all of our high expectations. It’s an affirmation that when voters have more options to cast their ballot safely and securely, they use them.
This is the first statewide election where Michigan citizens had three options to vote: voting from home; voting early in person; or voting at the polls on Election Day. After a nine-day early voting period where over a million Michiganders cast their ballots, and then a smooth, seamless Election Day, I’m thankful to every election worker who worked tirelessly to protect every vote.

Looking ahead, this primary election also marks the official beginning of the 2024 election cycle. I know the next several months will be noisy. We know that our votes in Michigan will have a nationwide impact, defining the future of not just our state, but of our country.
I’m inspired to see how many Michiganders took the first step this primary toward making their voices heard. As I’ve said before, democracy is a choice. All of us have a collective responsibility to protect it.

Our commitment to safe, secure, and transparent elections has never been stronger. I’m proud of what we’ve built in Michigan, and we’ll keep working to make it even better.
Thank you all for your continued support. Every day we keep doing the hard work together is another step toward building a stronger democratic legacy in Michigan.

-Jocelyn

Carville here.
**I’ve got to tell you: If we lose Pennsylvania, Democrats will blow a gasket.**
THIS IS IT. The whole country stands right here on the tipping point, and there’s absolutely no way we keep the Senate without PA. That’s just a fact.
That’s why I’m doing everything in my power to re-elect my dear friend Bob Casey. But at the same time, Mitch McConnell and his cronies are doing everything in their power to flip this seat and the Senate majority.
They’re gearing up to flood PA with millions upon millions of dollars in attacks, and Bob’s opponent has the resources to self-fund his campaign. We can’t compete with that kind of money without your help, Peter. Bob is counting on grassroots support to keep PA and the Senate blue.

In fact, the pro-gun group’s revenue has been on the decline for years now, especially since Parkland. Last year, their fundraising was at its lowest point since 2008. And since 2018 they have lost over 1 million members. I firmly believe that the NRA’s days are numbered—and as their power and influence fade into the dustbin of history, we will replace their corrupt, purchased politicians with a new generation of bold, courageous leaders who aren’t afraid to take urgent, necessary action to stop the scourge of gun violence in America. I co-founded Leaders We Deserve because Gen Z’s answer to the NRA is electing more and more young people to public office to counter their agenda. We founded Leaders We Deserve last year to elect the next generation of leadership—and folks across the country are already helping us shatter expectations. Not only have tens of thousands of people just like you joined our movement and helped spread the word about our mission, we’ve already elected our very first candidate. In the days leading up to the November election, we hit the streets in Virginia to knock on doors and get out the vote for Nadarius Clark. The economic onslaught we're enduring is not just alarming; it's a clear sign of catastrophic leadership failure.

Construction Materials

Manufacturing Costs

Refrigeration/HVAC, Wholesale Food

Animal Feed, Fertilizer

subject: LGBTQIA+ students should be safe at school
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Derek Marshall for Congress
body:
| | |
Peter, during this sorrowful time following the loss of Nex Benedict and in light of the destructive behaviors of the Oklahoma School board as well as the toxic messages disseminated by “Libs of TikTok,” it’s crucial now more than ever to stand in solidarity with trans and non-binary youth.
All kids, regardless of sexual orientation or gender identity deserve to be celebrated, supported, and protected, NOT targeted, discriminated against, or erased.
Every child deserves to feel safe, accepted, and loved for who they are. They deserve access to affirming healthcare, inclusive education, and supportive communities. They deserve to be able to express themselves authentically without fear of violence or discrimination.
The harmful bigotry spread by groups like the Libs of TikTok only perpetuates hate and intolerance towards marginalized communities.
We must actively work to create a more inclusive and supportive environment for every child in this nation, regardless of their gender identity or sexual orientation.
We are committed to advocating for equality, educating ourselves and others, and uplifting the voices of trans and non-binary kids to ensure they feel empowered and valued.
#ProtectTransKids #LoveisLove
-Derek Marshall for Congress

clean_body: | | | Peter, during this sorrowful time following the loss of Nex Benedict and in light of the destructive behaviors of the Oklahoma School board as well as the toxic messages disseminated by “Libs of TikTok,” it’s crucial now more than ever to stand in solidarity with trans and non-binary youth. All kids, regardless of sexual orientation or gender identity deserve to be celebrated, supported, and protected, NOT targeted, discriminated against, or erased. Every child deserves to feel safe, accepted, and loved for who they are. They deserve access to affirming healthcare, inclusive education, and supportive communities. They deserve to be able to express themselves authentically without fear of violence or discrimination. The harmful bigotry spread by groups like the Libs of TikTok only perpetuates hate and intolerance towards marginalized communities. We must actively work to create a more inclusive and supportive environment for every child in this nation, regardless of their gender identity or sexual orientation. We are committed to advocating for equality, educating ourselves and others, and uplifting the voices of trans and non-binary kids to ensure they feel empowered and valued. #ProtectTransKids #LoveisLove -Derek Marshall for Congress is a Democrat running for Congress in California's 23rd District. name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: care package from Pro-Life Friend
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

If you and I want our votes to matter in November, it’s what happens right now that’s really important. . .

You see, there’s no guarantee there will be ANY pro-life choices on the ballot in November with how weak-kneed some Republicans are becoming when it comes to saving babies from abortion.

**_Imagine how happy Planned Parenthood would be if that happens! Their killing sprees could continue no matter what!_**

The good news is, _Students for Life Action_ isn’t just sitting on our hands right now and hoping for the best.

Instead, we’re launching aggressive primary campaigns across 15 states where there are hotly-contested races between pro-life and pro-abortion Republicans.

**And one of the first is North Carolina, where we’re deploying an army of volunteer canvassers this weekend to go door-to-door in key districts before their primary election on March 5th!**

**[Can I count on you to make your most generous contribution to _Students for Life Action_ to help me equip our dedicated canvassers with the tools they’ll need to succeed](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-shkkyly-duchtdja-y/)?**

With North Carolina’s primary coming up fast, your support would be a big help!

Long hours, miles of walking, bad weather, doors slammed in faces, and even attacks from pro-abortion radicals are just some of the things our canvassers endure as they work.

They’re typically young students who also have school to worry about – _not to mention the attacks they also receive on campus!_

So, I know it would mean the world to them if – _after doing everything they can to make an impact for Life_ – you and I do as much as we can for them.

**[Even just $25 for a warm pizza that our canvassers can enjoy after a long day in the cold, would be greatly appreciated](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-shkkyly-duchtdja-j/).**

But what I’d really like to do is send them a whole care package to keep them going.

Something that says, _“Thanks for all your hard work, and God bless you!”_

Of course, a **[one-time Care Package Gift of $100](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-shkkyly-duchtdja-i/)** can provide door-knocking materials like _Students for Life Action_ shirts, flyers, postcards, markers, and more!

And a **[one-time Care Package Gift of $50](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-shkkyly-duchtdja-d/)** can pay for a tank of gas for a canvasser’s day of driving to and from strategic locations.

But, if you’d be willing to provide one canvasser with all the materials, gas, and meals they’ll need while they volunteer for us – _a whole care package_ – **[a generous Care Package Gift of $250 would accomplish that](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-shkkyly-duchtdja-h/).**

With North Carolina and many more states hanging in the balance in 2024, we can’t afford not to equip every canvasser with what they need!

These canvassers are the lifeblood of our election programs.

But it’s your generosity that keeps them going.

**[So please consider making your most generous Care Package Gift of $250, $100, $50, or even $25 to _Students for Life Action_ right away](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-shkkyly-duchtdja-k/).**

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

Students for Life Action is a non-profit, tax-exempt advocacy organization under section 501(c)(4) of the IRC. Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. clean_body: Dear Pro-Life Friend, If you and I want our votes to matter in November, it’s what happens right now that’s really important. . . You see, there’s no guarantee there will be ANY pro-life choices on the ballot in November with how weak-kneed some Republicans are becoming when it comes to saving babies from abortion. Imagine how happy Planned Parenthood would be if that happens! Their killing sprees could continue no matter what! The good news is, Students for Life Action isn’t just sitting on our hands right now and hoping for the best. Instead, we’re launching aggressive primary campaigns across 15 states where there are hotly-contested races between pro-life and pro-abortion Republicans. And one of the first is North Carolina, where we’re deploying an army of volunteer canvassers this weekend to go door-to-door in key districts before their primary election on March 5th! ? With North Carolina’s primary coming up fast, your support would be a big help! Long hours, miles of walking, bad weather, doors slammed in faces, and even attacks from pro-abortion radicals are just some of the things our canvassers endure as they work. They’re typically young students who also have school to worry about – not to mention the attacks they also receive on campus! So, I know it would mean the world to them if – after doing everything they can to make an impact for Life – you and I do as much as we can for them. . But what I’d really like to do is send them a whole care package to keep them going. Something that says, “Thanks for all your hard work, and God bless you!” Of course, a can provide door-knocking materials like Students for Life Action shirts, flyers, postcards, markers, and more! And a can pay for a tank of gas for a canvasser’s day of driving to and from strategic locations. But, if you’d be willing to provide one canvasser with all the materials, gas, and meals they’ll need while they volunteer for us – a whole care package – . With North Carolina and many more states hanging in the balance in 2024, we can’t afford not to equip every canvasser with what they need! These canvassers are the lifeblood of our election programs. But it’s your generosity that keeps them going. . Thank you for everything you do for Life. name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: Entering electoral crunch time / Entrando en los últimos días de las elecciones
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
VOTE NOW:
Make your voice heard in this primary election
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/English%20primary%20calendar%202024.jpg]
Your vote this primary election makes a difference in determining the quality of the candidate that makes their way to this fall's general election ballot. Collectively, WE have the power to advance progressive, people-powered candidates who will prioritize the needs of everyday working Texans and deliver the change that ALL our communities deserve.
Early vote started February 20, and runs through this Friday, March 1 in the Texas Democratic Primary. Election Day is March 5.
Find your polling place and check out what will be on your ballot! [https://tfn.org/resources/vote-in-texas-elections-hub/]
This primary election season, TOP members have voted to endorse:
Bexar County:
• Rebeca Clay-Flores [https://www.bexar.org/3341/Precinct-1-Commissioner-Rebeca-Clay-Flor] for Bexar County Commissioner, Pct. 1
• Kristian Carranza [https://kristianfortexas.com/] for Texas House, Dist. 118
Dallas County:
• Victoria Neave Criado [https://www.victoriafortexas.com/] for Texas Senate, Dist. 16
• Cassandra Hernandez [https://cassandrafortexas.com/] for Texas House, Dist. 115
• Derek Avery [https://derekfordallas.com/] for Dallas County Commissioner, Dist. 3
Harris County:
• Sean Teare [https://seanteareforda.com/] for Harris County District Attorney
• Christian Menefee [https://www.menefeeforhc.com/] for Harris County Attorney
• Sheila Jackson Lee [https://www.sheilajacksonlee.com/] for Congress (TX-18)
• Gion Thomas [https://www.gionfortexas.com/] for Congress (TX-38)
• Molly Cook [https://www.mollyfortexas.com/] for Texas Senate, Dist. 15
• Danyahel “Danny” Norris [https://dannynorris4tx.com/] for Texas House, Dist. 142
• Lauren Ashley Simmons [https://www.laurenashleysimmons.com/] for Texas House, Dist. 146
Travis County:
• José Garza [https://www.joseforda.com/] for Travis County District Attorney
PITCH IN to support TOP PAC's work to expand the electorate and shift the political landscape of our state. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/texas-organizing-project-political-action-committee-3?refcode2=131e5199-c4d6-ee11-85f9-002248223794]
Joining forces with Houston community allies to protest anti-immigrant law SB4
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Houston%20rodeo%20SB4.jpeg]
TOP, Texas Rising, and The Border Network for Human Rights rallied outside of the Houston Rodeo on Tuesday [https://www.houstonchronicle.com/news/houston-texas/article/houston-protest-senate-bill-4-18690584.php] to call on the Houston Police Department and Harris County Sheriff’s Office to not comply with SB4, the state’s new law targeting migrant families, and to end all collaboration with ICE.
This law was pushed by far-right Texas legislators, signed by Gov. Abbott last year, and is slated to take effect on March 5. SB4 is seen as the most extreme and cruel immigration law passed in Texas in modern history.
With this heinous law, Abbott and his enablers are pandering to white nationalists and right-wing extremists by enacting dangerous policy that will only sow fear in our immigrant communities.
SB4 is the most extreme anti-immigrant law our state has passed in modern times. It overrides national immigration law, violates the Constitution, and gives local law enforcement and certain judges the power to DEPORT PEOPLE WITHOUT DUE PROCESS.
Call or text TOP's Damaris Gonzalez at 832-774-7704 to learn more about our immigration justice organizing and get involved in fighting SB4!
Our 1st Takeover Texas Community Lunch is in the Books

[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Houston%20rodeo%20SB4.jpeg]

Esta ley fue impulsada por legisladores de extrema derecha de Texas, firmada por el gobernador Abbott el año pasado, y está programada para entrar en vigor el 5 de marzo. La SB4 es vista como la ley de inmigración más extrema y cruel aprobada en Texas en la historia moderna.

La SB4 es la ley antiinmigrante más extrema que nuestro estado ha aprobado en los tiempos modernos. Anula la ley de inmigración nacional, viola la Constitución y otorga a las autoridades locales y a ciertos jueces el poder de DEPORTAR A PERSONAS SIN EL DEBIDO PROCESO.

But here’s the thing: this isn’t all about crypto. **This is about a few billionaires trying to rig the election through millions of dollars worth of lies.** _That’s why today another paper reported that we’re battling for survival, as both super PACs attack us, and Adam Schiff spends more than $10M boosting our Republican opponent._

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: How do you uphold your religious liberty in today's climate?
body:
There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried

|
---
| | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c695775%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=datvuh3SEYYsNzWw5382Zw&sysid=1)
---
| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c695776%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=S9%2f258pnD4y1d45U1hWKrg&sysid=1) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c695777%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=MqMHypplVXAwma7%2fSd49Dg&sysid=1)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c695778%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=IVX9qoamsKaAGScKhNGu%2bQ&sysid=1)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute
---
---
| |
---
---
Your donation to ACI helps us to focus on our mission of promoting and preserving individual and religious liberty, helping our country’s most vulnerable find new hope, and developing methods to decrease the federal government’s role in society and to improve efficiency to best serve ALL our nation’s citizens.

I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years—which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zguuk8i91avibdit73affnmeqlf23rn4v81k3rq8_rp22sh2s8i6eo34s9g62ob1c9h2bs) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zpgibnnma1vsc3g1h9uf23ckh90nvrnq1qa19tg8_rp22sh2s8i6eo34s9g62ob1c9h2bs) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zonp0585ei2pthp6ed3o698slg8r2fr74ssof2h0_rp22sh2s8i6eo34s9g62ob1c9h2bs) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: How do you uphold your religious liberty in today's climate?
body:
There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried

|
---
| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z1aae7n9am4frmhurcd0k5rp7337ijgmru7guroo_rp22sh2s8i6eo34s9g62ob7clh2bs)
---
| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z2jgm10clfg4bb1vn2otp759sncmgll9t1uu483g_rp22sh2s8i6eo34s9g62ob7clh2bs) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zp0fpa9o508rfogvje8glslturqjd23c1eii38co_rp22sh2s8i6eo34s9g62ob7clh2bs)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zog9csoniqebbc27r9rc5sg5d2mk3ul0lgq1io10_rp22sh2s8i6eo34s9g62ob7clh2bs)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

| MANAKIN SABOT, VA -- 100% Pro-Trump 5th Congressional District candidate, former Navy SEAL, Virginia Senator, and business owner John McGuire today announced that he has been endorsed by the Chairman of the U.S. House Armed Services Committee, Mike Rogers.
---
| U.S. House Armed Services Committee Chairman Mike Rogers Endorses John McGuire for Congress
---
| | |
---|---
|
Chairman Rogers said:

"I'm fully endorsing John McGuire for Congress. His military background and service make it clear that he's committed to protecting this country. John has also gotten two tax breaks for Virginia veterans passed through the Legislature, so he's clearly effective at protecting those who have served. In contrast, Bob Good has not delivered for veterans in his district and has not prioritized service members during his time in Congress. That's why I'm supporting John McGuire."

Paid for and Authorized by McGuire for Virginia
| McGuire said:
"Thank you to Rep. Mike Rogers for supporting me and for supporting America's troops. When I go to Congress, I'm going to back our military 100 percent. Our troops will never have to wonder where I stand on supporting them."

My fellow citizens, Today, I write you with a heavy heart, burdened by the stark realities I witnessed firsthand at our nation's border. I embarked on a journey fueled by duty and curiosity, to delve into the depths of the border conflict that has gripped our nation's attention. What I encountered there was beyond comprehension, beyond what any of us could have imagined. In my pursuit of truth, I stumbled upon scenes that shook me to my core. I could not turn away, for it is our duty as leaders, as stewards of this great nation, to confront the harsh realities that confront us. With profound urgency, I present to you a brief glimpse into the depths of this crisis, a testament to the importance of addressing these challenges head-on. I implore each and every one of you to bear witness to this footage, to let it serve as a call to action, a rallying cry for compassion, for empathy, and for decisive action. Together, we can and we must confront the challenges that lie ahead, for the sake of our nation, for the sake of our humanity. Please, click the link below to view the video, and join me in the journey. I will be returning next week to spend a few days.
---

## Vote for these 7
---
|

|

**Vote for 7 people Central Committee, 66th Assembly District**
Dear friends and fellow Conservatives,
I am thrilled to announce that I am running for an official seat on the 66th Assembly District Central Committee. As some of you may know, I have been serving as an alternate on the committee for some time now. Over the past two years, I have also been actively involved in multiple posts within the party. I am proud to have been elected to the California Republican Assembly state board of directors as the Senate director for the 24th District, chaired the Faith Outreach committee for the CRA, and served as a delegate for the California State party. These experiences have given me a deep understanding of the values and principles that are important to our party and have prepared me to effectively represent our district on the central committee.
As a member of the central committee, I will work tirelessly to ensure that conservative values remain at the forefront of our party's agenda. I believe that my position on the LAGOP, which is the largest Republican party office in the nation, will allow me to have a greater impact on decisions that affect our party and our community. I have already been able to influence many decisions as an alternate, and I am confident that I can make an even greater impact as an elected member.
While some have urged me to run for the congressional seat of the 36th district, I believe that my calling is to bring balance to the party for the next few years. This will not only benefit the party but also other candidates and myself in the long run. Federal races can be expensive to operate, and I have learned from my previous run for Congress that it takes time to build relationships and secure the support needed to win. My goal is to help fix the foundation of the party while building relationships with those who can help me in the future.
I am asking for your prayers and support as I take this important step on my journey. Please look for me on the primary ballot on March 5, 2024. Early voting begins on February 24, 2024. Your vote for me, Derrick R. Gates, for the 66th Assembly Central Committee, will help ensure that our conservative values continue to be represented in our district and beyond.
Thank you for your support and dedication to our party.
Sincerely,
Derrick R. Gates

name: Hillsdale College via Full Mag News
subject: The Connection Between Faith and Freedom
body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years—which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from Full Mag News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ece1e3593b214086bbef21b84014d671&_e=rMcCM8kl8ibw2dQPVTmhPcHrYygw299RajNgFFDWn6YSsaOBpSROYeu-lHKbKoNBNBrr8KfZMmVDFhFUfywP8DN4tSnBO4UDYTUtl06yDkWTW14rwnPCb-173WVTQffYOu68wKYnvqE3TZRb2klIlvJRdPImohVPyHJPSItdcFRRrdRiLjeCE9J3c2W9AzLin_e6QLQ2RuKeHlKJSk7KZFGqg03VcEO0o5nj6FgOiC5NVum9EWs0VsjoVhTpUuQ7zHUdVE8R_pJHzzVTkE6mGkJXypM50coq2ejmI6vBfA6nQN1SHafs7Xzf4wCZ-wt6RhR_hkCuQQo1SOBpkur-WChe0t4GyKcRd4GPbGqqDO5M7frz-wfY7uoIH0JoIvATMhX3ieTSV9YMhiHbMS_zyg%3D%3D) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ece1e3593b214086bbef21b84014d671&_e=rMcCM8kl8ibw2dQPVTmhPcHrYygw299RajNgFFDWn6YSsaOBpSROYeu-lHKbKoNBNBrr8KfZMmVDFhFUfywP8DN4tSnBO4UDYTUtl06yDkWTW14rwnPCb-173WVTQffYOu68wKYnvqE3TZRb2klIlvJRdPImohVPyHJPSItdcFRRrdRiLjeCE9J3c2W9AzLin_e6QLQ2RuKeHlKJSk7KZFGqg03VcEO0o5nj6FgOiC5NVum9EWs0VsjoVhTpUuQ7L6ePFCb5RdP3iMK2nx140xUZB5X-Yp-eg_KzjTtd_yxrcmiJJNNf0_7bSwzuur_YZ_jZpKpKwtZP0FklsTPpdSO0zOl4dDyC-pGkiWZDnHq_1pDZqwYGjbluyEPX76ExUcCF1g3yUHEQ8-QOx5o__Q%3D%3D) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ece1e3593b214086bbef21b84014d671&_e=rMcCM8kl8ibw2dQPVTmhPcHrYygw299RajNgFFDWn6YSsaOBpSROYeu-lHKbKoNBNBrr8KfZMmVDFhFUfywP8DN4tSnBO4UDYTUtl06yDkWTW14rwnPCb-173WVTQffYOu68wKYnvqE3TZRb2klIlvJRdPImohVPyHJPSItdcFRRrdRiLjeCE9J3c2W9AzLin_e6QLQ2RuKeHlKJSk7KZFGqg03VcEO0o5nj6FgOiC5NVum9EWs0VsjoVhTpUuQ7NhnCVPhvVZ1JDB309umLffYnNT1hZGfLRE20MN-kgjstc-yOR6jMIF_SJ5x7rmQkIsXfMrgQLvDW6kaZLNIu9tjGXK-dWrPEr6exJtgVtrFh3RlXP66stusD5_Lf7B7iTg1hDxEGfsgLeySFfvwRWw%3D%3D) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

name: Steve Garvey
subject: Defeat Adam Schiff
disclaimer_text:
PAID FOR
BY STEVE GARVEY FOR U
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWHdCpaiNk

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWHdCpaiNk

Dear
Fellow Patriot,
If you
opened this email because you remember my playing days with the
Dodgers and the Padres, thank you.

Having
you and all of America's baseball fans cheering for me and Davey
Lopes, Bill Russell, Ron Cey and the rest of the guys as we
battled Reggie Jackson, Thurman Munson and the Yankees...
...well,
as they say, "Those were the days."
But this
email isn't about baseball. In fact, it's a email I never thought
I'd be writing to you.

Today,
I'm asking you to help me defeat the radical Adam Schiff for a
seat in the United States Senate.
Today,
I'm asking you to help me start a Republican Comeback Rally that
folks will be talking about for generations to come.
Because
when you think about it, those 'good-ol' days of the 1970s
weren't as good as we tend to first remember.
Baseball
was just a welcome distraction from the gloom and malaise that
had settled on our country thanks to one failed Democrat policy
after another.
I'm
running for the United States Senate because 2024 America is
starting to look a lot like 1970s America.
You
remember what it was like:
- Not
only were gas prices sky high, Carter's rationing meant we could
only buy gas on even or odd days depending on our license plate
numbers.Remember?
- Eleven
Israeli athletes were slaughtered at the Olympic Village in
Munich by terrorists.Remember?
-
Fifty-two Americans were held hostage for 444 days by terrorists
in Iran.Remember??
Democrat
policies had brought America to its knees.
And now,
as Yogi Berra used to say, "It's déjà vu all over again."
There's
fear of walking down the street because of rampant crime,
homelessness, and drug addiction. The cost of living is exploding
and for the first time causing more people to leave California.
Joe
Biden, Adam Schiff and the rest of the Democrats don't care one
bit that Americans are having a hard time. I'd go even further to
say they welcome the misery so they can keep folks down and
dependent.
And I
wouldn't blame you if you said, "Steve, I'm afraid America's best
days are behind us."
But
listen, here's something I also want you to remember...
We
Republicans pulled our country out of that 1970's Democratic
malaise by electing Ronald Reagan.
We put
classic conservative values at the heart of everything we did.
And
America became a shining city upon a hill once more.
We can do
that again.
It starts
by stunning the Democrats with a Senate win in California.
But
there's no way I can pull it off without you.
That's
why I'm asking you to rush in your $35 donation today
I'm sorry
for the urgency but the primary is in less than three months and
here's where things stand...
In March,
I need to be one of the top 2 vote-getters to get to the November
general election.
Adam
Schiff will probably take the #1 spot. And polls have me hot on
his heels for the #2 spot.
Once
we're passed the primary, I know with your help, I can beat him
in November.
Why?
First...
I've lived and worked in California for over 50 years, and I can
tell you -- voters here have had it with the Democrats like I've
never seen before.
They are
hungry for change, and if you and I work together to reach voters
in every neighborhood, on every beach, in every corner of
California...
I know we
can turn this historic opportunity into a Republican win.
Second...
you know I'm not a career politician.
But I do
have the one thing a Republican needs to get elected in
California...
...name
recognition.
I'm no
Schwarzenegger and I'd certainly never dare compare myself to
President Reagan.
But
California voters know me.
And Adam
Schiff and the Democrats are shaking in their boots seeing how
quickly I rose in the polls after entering the race.
As I'm
writing you this email, there are just a few percentage points
separating us.

| Fellow American,

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d673a5570a394e44b59cf926060bfeb1&_e=bE-e1Y_0ila-XXr5_GL5aSjAGF-IEIKZiwAm2bYT6y4HJquBA9CSnX4DjSA9kgZbKxFgAJFKkpowE8MRtshvUiMHPn6rPXuMTxEr_UxnQM9FDZVje8VF0a8g4j1KyMr3df04t8ZLqwzMOUQn94HF64-yvjRmaa8tRBI2K4rXtVFqGEhC3a1MyYabmt2LtJRvWUwO5BC7S7vVy0qSTon8zd8QW8_sylzMSAoEuJG0teNkE4xOr7t-QkIZ5_ufrp453r2hA0G5NewLXdCMyjJoyUzaE_xcoQRb_bB-niiGwu9UrNMCORrgtqNDKoqIs4IHfIwCWl3MRwjHz5BkhM8xjQVaPZdS76f42dDXkxd1_RMvb_jsrhl9OhnUDEn2fThjAN4FlXlTsn_e3XIwmMyZnF1_QN7qUFO8Vn1clPYu_No%3D)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d673a5570a394e44b59cf926060bfeb1&_e=bE-e1Y_0ila-XXr5_GL5aSjAGF-IEIKZiwAm2bYT6y4HJquBA9CSnX4DjSA9kgZbKxFgAJFKkpowE8MRtshvUiMHPn6rPXuMTxEr_UxnQM9FDZVje8VF0a8g4j1KyMr3df04t8ZLqwzMOUQn94HF64-yvjRmaa8tRBI2K4rXtVFqGEhC3a1MyYabmt2LtJRvWUwO5BC7S7vVy0qSTon8zd8QW8_sylzMSAoEuJG0teNkE4xOr7t-QkIZ5_ufrp453r2hA0G5NewLXdCMyjJoyffaOylSBA4uoBJGbVR035K6XQgr3O_yOZ36ukRoanSiEQYE_dgltztVD9Ol8PKiuh2eZWq6YiVGghktdmUGn-J3nXvk_Ec8B6AWUQVT5IFovoSvGa0Ph5-A0AiFdIn5hI-gxU44cnjsbIpM35ZAvK4%3D)**

Furthermore, an amendment to the Respect for Marriage Act , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed. This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life. Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith? Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America. Thank you for your consideration. ** It's Time to Qualify!!
------------------------------------------------------------

How time flies! In the blink of an eye, we are less than a week away from candidate qualifications here in Georgia. This is an exciting time for the campaign as we get one step closer to flipping the 7th Congressional District and taking back the United States House of Representatives.

If you are unfamiliar with the process, Candidate Qualification Week is the official timeframe when candidates submit the required paperwork and pay the associated fees to have their name on the ballot. This year Qualification is March 4 - March 8. The process is the same for every level of government, with only the location to register and the amount of the fee being different. For federal candidates in Georgia, this is a trip to the Gold Dome in Atlanta with a check for $5,220.
Donate Now (http://secure.actblue.com/donate/christianforga6?utm_source=Christian+For+Congress&utm_campaign=6541429b2e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_29_07_30&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6541429b2e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

**
------------------------------------------------------------

Our race has not been considered worthy of national attention because it is not seen as a winnable contest by the political establishment. I believe it is incredibly important. This is the third congressional district for me in 6 years because Georgia’s Republican controlled government has done its best to change districts to keep themselves in power. At the federal level, Georgia Republicans continue to tow the party line, speaking against future-forward investments while welcoming the new jobs and technological advances the largest infrastructure bill in our history has brought to north Georgia.

This is a challenging time for the Christian for Congress team. We have traveled across north Georgia to listen to voters to understand what is important to you. I have held weekly online meetings to keep you up on what is happening in your government. Despite the massive support in meeting rooms and digital spaces, we are behind. As we approach end-of-month fundraising goals, facing the biggest expense of the race thus far, my monetary support does not meet my online and in-person support. That means that, once again, if those of us who live in the 7th District want the representation, we deserve it will be up to us to take action. So today, we are setting a fundraising goal of $5,000 through this weekend to give us the opportunity to make a strong showing during qualification and allow the campaign to come out swinging in what is sure to be a heated primary season.

Congressional campaigns can cost hundreds of thousands, if not millions, of dollars to run. Fortunately, the Christian for Congress team has perfected ways to run on way less than that -- so I am not asking you for that much money. I do, however, need your help with the little steps along the way. Consider the following giving recommendations:
* The cost of a coffee run
* $20.24
* One dollar for every year of your life

These small amounts make a big difference. If everyone on my email list donates $10, I will reach my $5,000 goal. So please, give what you can keeping in mind two things: the maximum individual donation this cycle is $3,300, and every little bit helps.

Obviously, qualification is critical. Without candidates on the ballot, north Georgians will be deprived of voices that stand for them. The gerrymanderers will have won. We can't let this happen, but, sadly we have already seen this scenario playing out across our state. In both the 11th and 9th Congressional Districts, Democrats have lost great candidates -- Antonio Daza and Mike Ford, respectively -- primarily because of a lack of funding.

Like most grassroots organizations I am blessed to have an overwhelming number of volunteers ready to make phone calls, knock on doors, and do the day-to-day grunt work of campaigning. Dozens of truly talented individuals are generously donating their skills and knowledge to help me build my team in the early stages of this contest. The only ingredient that is missing from the equation is money.

This is a tough question for me. I do not like asking for money. But despite what the media thinks, I believe the 7th Congressional District is important. This is a big mountain to climb and it is going to take all of us to reach the top. As my team continues to build our coalition and make your voices heard across the state and the nation, I can't begin to describe how honored and humbled I am that y'all have allowed me to be your candidate and nominee. It is truly an experience that I will never forget, and I believe it will only be topped by the feelings that will come when you elect me as a United States Representative for the 7th Congressional District of Georgia.

Let’s give them a real race. Help me speak up for you.

Crossover Day at State Capitol
Thursday, Feb 29 - The last day a bill can clear its originating chamber and move to the other chamber for consideration. A bill introduced in the Senate must pass the Senate by the end of Thursday to be considered in the House and vice versa.

Republican Budget Fight
Friday, Mar 1 - Once again, Congressional Republicans are pushing us to the brink of a government shutdown. Anticipate a heated argument and then the passage of another continuing resolution as the GOP continues to fail at problem solving.

Presidential Primary Voting
Early voting for the Presidential Primary continues through March 8, with Saturday voting available this weekend on March 2. The election will be held March 12.

Coffee & Conversations
Saturday, Mar 2 - Meet and greet with residents of Cherokee County.

Candidate Qualification at the Georgia Dome
Monday, Mar 4 - Friday, Mar 8 - Official registration period candidates at all levels in Georgia. Multiple appearances through the week.

7th District Happy Hour
Thursday, March 7 - Meet and greet with residents of the newly drawn 7th Congressional Distrct
