[**If you can chip in right now, your gift will help mobilize against harmful legislation, advance policies that make it easier for people to make their voices heard, respond to future threats to our fundamental rights, and more.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79995364/458137413/1809509950?refcode=bsc_emm_ffa_20240229_f_crossoverday_v1s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYjMzYjQ4Yy0yOGQ3LWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=c-bgVAXLILcI2Ka0_F0xnaj3fK-qJlegGN3pMK4lWfA=) Here’s what you need to know about these two dangerous pieces of legislation:

* SB 88 is a “Don’t Say Gay'' bill that singles out the topic of gender identity in schools for specific regulation — a practice that could stigmatize LGBTQ+ youth. This anti-democratic educational censorship would restrict private school educators in the classroom and set the stage for public school districts to force teachers to out transgender students to their parents.

It’s no surprise that the same lawmakers who are trying to restrict our freedom to vote are also attacking the LGBTQ+ community. body:
What I love most about this job is the opportunity to work for Kansans every single day, to bring our values and our interests to Washington.

Today’s the last day of the month, which means you’re probably getting inundated with campaigns asking you for help before tonight’s deadline. I’m sorry for my role in your overflowing email inbox. But this note isn’t just to ask for your support. It’s also to thank you for everything you’ve done to get me where I am today, and to talk candidly about why the tough fight we’re gearing up for is so, so important. My background is pretty unique in the House of Representatives. I was raised by a single mom and was the first person from my family to attend college (not the norm in Congress, but not unheard of). I juggled multiple jobs to pay my way through school (even less common for Congress). I started my career working in economic and community development on Native American reservations (very unusual for DC). And I was proud to become the first LGBTQ+ Native American elected to Congress (first but hopefully not the last!). So it’s true that I bring a unique voice to Congress. But ultimately, what I’m proudest of isn’t _getting_ to Washington. Having a voice only matters if you use it well. What I love most about this job is the opportunity to work for Kansans every single day, to bring our values and our interests to Washington. Sometimes, that means fighting back against extremism — doing everything I can to defeat attacks on our democracy and our fundamental freedoms. But I’m not here just to say no to harmful policies. I’m here to pass good ones, to deliver opportunities for the people of Kansas. And I’m proudly running for re-election on my record of doing exactly that — whether it was reducing the cost of insulin for Kansans who are on Medicare, helping to bring good-paying clean-energy jobs here to KS-03, or expanding rural broadband access in rural communities. I’m thankful every day for this opportunity to serve the people of Kansas, and I’m grateful for everything you’ve done to make this opportunity possible — whether you’ve donated a few hard-earned dollars, volunteered, or spread the word about our campaign on social media. The fact is, despite all we’ve achieved, we’ve got our work cut out for us this year. This election is going to be really, really close, and the stakes could not be higher. If you’re still with me in this fight, and you’re able to contribute, I would be sincerely grateful if you could pitch in before tonight’s fundraising deadline: [_**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/davids-email-feb24?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79995711/458138415/837329752?refcode=email_022924_EOM3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMDg2Njg0ZS0yOWQ3LWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YiU6e7lv6NLgkg61JOkn7RAbkWA00NoJi1n6dVcwwcE=) And regardless of whether or not you decide to chip in today, I want to thank you again for all your support. It means the world to me, and to our entire grassroots team. Thank you, Sharice

Peter,

We have **insufficient funds** to defend this seat and the Republican Majority.

We're not stopping anytime soon **[as long as I have your support](https://email.email.conservativemajorityaction.com/c/eJxckc-OmzAQh59muIHM2MDmwGG7lErNoUpUaY-rwR4Sd7GNwFCRp6-IaA-9fr9v_mnIjYPttxqqL4B4t2YGRJCvgPh-PW9ncuvr1_TxbtIf5fXbnuEbIMZt5H_i0SNjR3bYadUkpi4MGxIJ13klTiiFelHJvca-QE15rrQwue4KZToq-rLjUyXynorE1ihQCcRT_pIrJbOiNAaFUCcUpJElKPEclOngZ55WinZlR7_CZONGOtrgMx1cMtT3GMf5uWIL2M6sl4kz8mxC3A3ANnwy9-zYWLpNYRkBW_a3MAWfui6lFWS7RPcxh2XSDLI5QsByx3vd4kA2tB5EkxvJ3jzIxnV_WfCRfQTZeD2kj_HzzV8u35efgOWHH6wB2fwHn1-QzdVc4lmUyVSb8bcdBjuXFShxO453fwIAAP__o6mOIA).**

The pace of our investigations is breakneck, but my team and I have unrelenting enthusiasm. Our tip lines are overflowing, and the whistleblowers keep on coming.

So please help us keep up with the growing expenses and fund payroll through next week. I can't tell you how grateful I am for your support, and I'll do my best to repay your generosity through my work.

Thank you again for all that you do.

James O'Keefe

Derek,

Wisconsin is expected to be the closest state in the country in 2024. With

as MAGA extremists like Donald Trump try to destroy it.

[ https://go.tonyevers.com/go/2231?amount=&refcode=EM_NBI_FR_Feb2024_MMFR_0_3MO_TonyEvers_NA_NA_1.5&t=1001&akid=6628%2E1827488%2EVar-xb ]Before I tell you why this is important, and how we can fight back, can

fundraising goal before the deadline tonight at midnight?

MAGA Republicans, led by the likely Republican nominee Donald Trump,
aren’t even trying to hide their attempts to end fair elections.

We’re witnessing threats to our democracy and we must fight back. The

body:
| | | [ ](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzs2u921EReiR88ARqrt5HWpbBPunnEofCMh9dr_AFzKQYUVvbzO-M-vvPEennCGLAmeix7qFDIkH9lYJir8ZJnt&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=022924_blankenship&n=1)
---
Dear Friend, Recently, my primary election opponent, Don Blankenship, made a statement that strikes at the very heart of our democracy, claiming that the American Government is the "worst enemy" of our people. This isn't just an attack on an institution; it's a betrayal of the very essence of our nation, where the government is not an external force but a reflection of us all - our collective will, our shared aspirations.
---
[ ](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzs2u921EReiR88ARqrt5HWpbBPunnEofCMh9dr_AFzKQYUVvbzO-M-vvPEennCGLAmeix7qFDIkH9lYJir8ZJnt&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=022924_blankenship&n=2)
---
Blankenship's past as CEO of Massey Energy paints a clear picture of his priorities. His tenure led to devastating consequences, including the tragic loss of 29 miners due to gross negligence and a blatant disregard for safety. His conviction for violating mine safety laws is a stark reminder of his disregard for the well-being of working people. And now, he seeks a position where he can extend his harmful influence to the very fabric of our nation. **But we know better.** We understand that our government, at its best, is the tool by which we safeguard the well-being of every citizen, protect our environment, and ensure fair and just opportunities for all. It's time we reclaim this powerful tool from those who seek to wield it for personal gain and restore it to its rightful place: in the hands of the people.

Our campaign is about more than just winning an election; it's about transforming our political landscape into one that truly represents the values and needs of working people. It's about ensuring that our government is of the people, by the people, and for the people. **I cannot do this alone.** It's February 29, and we only have 75 days before the West Virginia primary election that decides the Democratic Party nominee for the U.S. Senate. We are building a movement among Democratic voters and those disenchanted by the Democratic Party. I'm counting on you to help us bring working folks' voices to the halls of the Senate. clean_body: | | | Dear Friend, Recently, my primary election opponent, Don Blankenship, made a statement that strikes at the very heart of our democracy, claiming that the American Government is the "worst enemy" of our people. This isn't just an attack on an institution; it's a betrayal of the very essence of our nation, where the government is not an external force but a reflection of us all - our collective will, our shared aspirations. Blankenship's past as CEO of Massey Energy paints a clear picture of his priorities. His tenure led to devastating consequences, including the tragic loss of 29 miners due to gross negligence and a blatant disregard for safety. His conviction for violating mine safety laws is a stark reminder of his disregard for the well-being of working people. And now, he seeks a position where he can extend his harmful influence to the very fabric of our nation. But we know better. We understand that our government, at its best, is the tool by which we safeguard the well-being of every citizen, protect our environment, and ensure fair and just opportunities for all. It's time we reclaim this powerful tool from those who seek to wield it for personal gain and restore it to its rightful place: in the hands of the people. | "DONATE >>" I'm not just a candidate but a fellow worker, a member of our community who has lived the struggles of the working class. My vision for our country is one where policies are crafted for the common good, where healthcare is a right, not a privilege, and where the economy serves all of us, not just the wealthy few. Our campaign is about more than just winning an election; it's about transforming our political landscape into one that truly represents the values and needs of working people. It's about ensuring that our government is of the people, by the people, and for the people. I cannot do this alone. It's February 29, and we only have 75 days before the West Virginia primary election that decides the Democratic Party nominee for the U.S. Senate. We are building a movement among Democratic voters and those disenchanted by the Democratic Party. I'm counting on you to help us bring working folks' voices to the halls of the Senate. Our average contribution is still just $33.99. We can and will build a future that reflects our shared values and aspirations. In Solidarity, Zach Shrewsbury (D-WV) Candidate, U.S. Senate | "DONATE >>" | | Zach Shrewsbury (D-WV) is running for the U.S. Senate seat as the only electable Democrat in the race. A native West Virginian, a Marine Corps veteran, and a grandson of a coal miner, Zach has a passion for making a difference in his community. He has seen firsthand the struggles faced by working families who are just trying to get by. Zach's military service experiences and his work as a community and climate justice organizer shaped his commitment to fighting for social and economic justice, and he's dedicated his career to making a difference in people's lives. | | | ---|---|--- Shrewsbury for Senate · PO Box 82, Fayetteville, WV 25840, United States

From serving on student council and being the captain of his soccer team to little things like calling his grandparents to say hello and writing thank you notes because he knew they'd make someone feel valued, he always wanted to do what he could to make the world a little brighter. Helping people has always been second nature to Nick, and I am so proud of everything he's done over the last few months. He's done an incredible job of building this people-powered movement, and I know he'll work just as hard to make sure our community is proud, too. = We're just days away from watching this leap pay off for our community, and I've seen Nick put in the hard work. He's been talking to our neighbors, listening to what our community needs, and earning people's trust. And take it from someone who knows him best — the energy and work that Nick has put into this race is exactly the same energy that he will bring to Congress. = = Thank you so much, Peter, for standing with Nick in the final days of this race. Peter,

Valentine's Day has come and gone, but that doesn’t mean I still can’t reflect on the people and the community that bring love into my life.

Throughout my time in Congress, I have been proud to fight on behalf of WA-08’s interests – from preserving our beautiful forests and waterways to funding critical infrastructure projects across the district, and so much more. And I couldn’t have done it without the love and support I have received from my family, friends, and community.

I could go on and on, but as a Washingtonian, I can say for certain that our state, its beauty, and its values will always hold a special place in my heart.

I’d love nothing more than to continue fighting on behalf of WA-08, but this is the reality: _National Republicans are doing everything they can to ensure they flip this seat red._ If they succeed, it would have devastating consequences for Washingtonians and Americans alike. The GOP anti-woman, climate change-denying, Social Security-slashing, book-banning agenda has no place in Congress, and we must do everything we can to stop it.

Can I share something with you? When I first decided to run for office, I could have never expected how the next few years would go. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80006745/458173090/-828485359?refcode=AU_JC_FR_GEN_EOM_AC30_20240229_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODUyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYzdiNGJlYy0zOGQ3LWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=B-2P6wlby1dQCOKNcV0jS6GV88nHZooHnN8FlL40khY=) In 2019, just a year into serving in Congress, then-Speaker Nancy Pelosi chose me to be a manager for Donald Trump’s first impeachment trial. Newspapers said it was “unexpected,” with the Denver Post calling me a “surprise pick” for the job. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80006746/458173091/-828485359?refcode=AU_JC_FR_GEN_EOM_AC30_20240229_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODUyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYzdiNGJlYy0zOGQ3LWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=B-2P6wlby1dQCOKNcV0jS6GV88nHZooHnN8FlL40khY=) And to some extent, they were right. Congress is a body of tradition. It takes time to gain seniority — and as a freshman legislator, you’re at the bottom of the rung. I didn’t come from the usual political background like others before me. But as a former Army Ranger, I was an outspoken voice in defending our national security and advocating for our men and women in arms. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80006749/458173094/-828485359?refcode=AU_JC_FR_GEN_EOM_AC30_20240229_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODUyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYzdiNGJlYy0zOGQ3LWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=B-2P6wlby1dQCOKNcV0jS6GV88nHZooHnN8FlL40khY=) So while I didn’t have the same experiences, I knew we could bring a new perspective to the job. I worked to sift through mountains of evidence and lay out the case to indict Donald J. Trump. But that fight didn’t end after the trial: In the years since, Donald Trump and his MAGA allies have continued to threaten our democracy and rule of law for personal gain — culminating in this November’s election. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80006751/458173096/-828485359?refcode=AU_JC_FR_GEN_EOM_AC30_20240229_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODUyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYzdiNGJlYy0zOGQ3LWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=B-2P6wlby1dQCOKNcV0jS6GV88nHZooHnN8FlL40khY=) But this election is about more than just Donald Trump. It’s about protecting our values — like the freedom to vote, the freedom to make our own health care decisions, and the freedom for every family to achieve their American Dream. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80006753/458173098/-828485359?refcode=AU_JC_FR_GEN_EOM_AC30_20240229_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODUyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYzdiNGJlYy0zOGQ3LWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=B-2P6wlby1dQCOKNcV0jS6GV88nHZooHnN8FlL40khY=) We can’t afford to pass the buck any longer. We need leaders who are ready to step up to the plate and solve the problems that Americans have struggled with for years. That starts by taking back the House majority and restoring commonsense leadership to Congress. **[Can I count on you to donate $10 to help us hit our February fundraising goal, so we can fight to keep Colorado blue and flip the House?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80006755/458173100/-828485359?amount=10&refcode=AU_JC_FR_GEN_EOM_AC30_20240229_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODUyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYzdiNGJlYy0zOGQ3LWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=B-2P6wlby1dQCOKNcV0jS6GV88nHZooHnN8FlL40khY=)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [DONATE $10 NOW](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80006757/458173102/-828485359?amount=10&express_lane=true&refcode=AU_JC_FR_GEN_EOM_AC30_20240229_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODUyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYzdiNGJlYy0zOGQ3LWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=B-2P6wlby1dQCOKNcV0jS6GV88nHZooHnN8FlL40khY=)

clean_body: | Can I share something with you? When I first decided to run for office, I could have never expected how the next few years would go. = In 2019, just a year into serving in Congress, then-Speaker Nancy Pelosi chose me to be a manager for Donald Trump’s first impeachment trial. Newspapers said it was “unexpected,” with the Denver Post calling me a “surprise pick” for the job. = And to some extent, they were right. Congress is a body of tradition. It takes time to gain seniority — and as a freshman legislator, you’re at the bottom of the rung. I didn’t come from the usual political background like others before me. But as a former Army Ranger, I was an outspoken voice in defending our national security and advocating for our men and women in arms. = So while I didn’t have the same experiences, I knew we could bring a new perspective to the job. I worked to sift through mountains of evidence and lay out the case to indict Donald J. Trump. But that fight didn’t end after the trial: In the years since, Donald Trump and his MAGA allies have continued to threaten our democracy and rule of law for personal gain — culminating in this November’s election. = But this election is about more than just Donald Trump. It’s about protecting our values — like the freedom to vote, the freedom to make our own health care decisions, and the freedom for every family to achieve their American Dream. = We can’t afford to pass the buck any longer. We need leaders who are ready to step up to the plate and solve the problems that Americans have struggled with for years. Peter Willis, the
political establishment and dark money pro-Netanyahu PACs are doing
everything they can to get folks to ignore the massive victory for the
pro-Peace voting bloc in Michigan.

The media rushed to say that the “Uncommitted” vote means nothing. Really?
100,000 voters speaking out for Gaza means a great deal and has already
made a major impact — we’re hearing talk of “temporary ceasefire” and must
keep pushing for a permanent end to this horror.

Then AIPAC — a right-wing special interest group that supports
insurrectionists and corporate Democrats that has pledged to spend $100
million in elections against pro-Peace progressives — and its allies like
the Democratic Majority for Israel (DMFI), joined in sending texts to try
to blunt our momentum for Peace and minimize the voice of 100,000
Democratic voters.

DMFI is the group that spent millions to defeat Bernie in the 2020
Democratic presidential primary as soon as he gained momentum. The
political establishment and dark money groups will do anything to silence
candidates calling for Peace and the Democratic voters who want to end the
war on Gaza.

average donation in 2024 is just $17.11 — so each and every time you
contribute, you’re helping us organize against big money.

Frankly, President Biden can’t afford to lose any votes from the
Democratic base if he’s going to win Michigan and defeat Trump in
November. Yet, this is what DMFI and AIPAC think of 100,000 people using
their voice to stop the murder of tens of thousands of Palestinian
civilians:

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/15669?t=1052&akid=5385%2E5885482%2EyzrIW4 ][IMG]

Here’s the truth: Our Revolution went all-in to turnout our progressive
base to make Michigan a megaphone for Peace — and by doing so, we
delivered an electoral wake-up call that the President cannot ignore.

But here’s another truth: AIPAC, DMFI, and the political establishment
will go all-in to defeat the progressives who speak out for Palestinian
human rights and peace in Gaza.

This is all a reminder that we must never become comfortable with an
American campaign finance system where the slightest advocacy for peace or
criticism of a bombing campaign killing tens of thousands of civilians
leads to $100 million lined up against Peace candidates. That’s not
democracy, it’s big money trying to silence the voices of peace in
Congress.

We can’t lose our progressive advocates for peace in Congress as AIPAC
looks to target Pramila Jayapal, AOC, Ilhan Omar, Rashida Tlaib, Summer
Lee, and others. And we must elect one of our strongest Peace candidates,
Barbara Lee, to the Senate on Tuesday!

cutting it.

We’re still reaching the undecided voters in California — making sure they
know what I believe in and how I’ll fight for them.

For some of these folks, whether or not we reach them with our ads might
make the difference between them not voting at all.

We have an important fundraising deadline at midnight, but I’m more
focused on the election deadline in 5 days.

After watching her mom work double shifts to pay the bills, Debbie got a job at the local doughnut shop. Her minimum wage checks were small, but they helped make ends meet. Eventually that doughnut shop job made it possible for her to put herself through college, pursue a career of service, and become the first South American immigrant ever elected to Congress. Now, Debbie is running for Senate against a megamillionaire who spent $64 MILLION to buy this seat last time around. But she’s not scared. Debbie knows that just $10, about the cost of a dozen doughnuts, can be enough to change everything. Just $10 will help her run ads to fight back against Scott’s lies. Just $10 will help her hire incredible staff and travel around the state to meet voters. Just $10 will help her turn out the vote in blue districts, register new voters, and reach swing voters who could make or break this election. Just $10 could be enough to defeat Rick Scott and save our Senate majority. So I’m asking one final time:= | | = Thank you, Chuck Schumer | * | | | = Debbie Mucarsel-Powell is a Floridian, South American immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. She’s dedicated her life to uplifting working families, ending gun violence, and fighting for her community. Now, she’s running to defeat Republican Senator Rick Scott and win a better, brighter future for Florida.

The statement shall include the number and percentage of diverse directors who identify as female or as representing a national, racial, ethnic, indigenous, or cultural minority in the country of the business's principal executive offices. [H.B. 1404](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010xdQ7TkMKaLF0W7r2SEZNXZbRHI9DZh1GxKWisP2VHYrW4P8ROch9OBtAA_tCULQjLfHj5U43Dxds5avTS2-MopSIb-Ku6ZvkBkegnXLXNb94p2Ul7vVOPRcm9GhqKp9XOyMGXxXm8pVkMXnJDz3LbkbEVaHPlZG-JXG4c-JpY0WYbU8BDjKWAY5SeTU04BJK1yIV_eBWr8=&c=2ryD5m_VUQ9BL9P33qw9bZa5XYjlMuK4RO2-_IaPPx5LuqQnQDYCEw==&ch=k8NVk1JI7Nqgua-LQeS0CDqlJulWlYyB2-t_3sXhzMNUOnlNL9ZW5w==) Patron: Ward Department of Small Business and Supplier Diversity; Small SWaM Business Procurement Enhancement Program established; disparity study report. Establishes the Small SWaM Business Procurement Enhancement Program with a statewide goal of 42 percent of certified small SWaM business utilization in all discretionary spending by executive branch agencies and covered institutions in procurement orders, prime contracts, and subcontracts, as well as a target goal of 50 percent subcontracting to small SWaM businesses in instances where the prime contractor is not a small SWaM business for all new capital outlay construction solicitations that are issued. Executive branch agencies and covered institutions are required to increase their small SWaM business utilization rate by three percent per year until reaching the 42 percent target level or, if unable to do so, to implement achievable goals to increase their utilization rate. In addition, the bill provides for a small SWaM business set-aside for state agency and covered institution purchases of goods, services, and construction, requiring that purchases up to $100,000 be set aside for award to certified small SWaM businesses.

name: Hill Harper
subject: Why are we talking about this again???
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY HILL HARPER FOR MICHIGAN
body:
This is just embarrassing.
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1023%2E62735%2EFHPDhT)
Hey, Peter — it’s Hill. I wanted to quickly share this headline from **NBC News** with you:
[](https://act.hillharper.com/go/473?t=2&akid=1023%2E62735%2EFHPDhT)
“For now?” I couldn’t help but read that and ask myself: **_Why are we talking about this again?_** In the last six months alone, our “leaders” have brought us to the brink of total or partial government shutdown three times — another embarrassing example of our broken system at play.
I don’t know about you, Peter, but I’m damn tired of this back and forth in Washington, and I think it’s time to shake things up. **[If you are too, I need you to chip in $5 before my end-of-month deadline tonight to send me to the Senate. With your help, I’ll work with whoever it takes to clean up this mess and put Congress back to work for the people.](https://act.hillharper.com/go/475?t=4&akid=1023%2E62735%2EFHPDhT)**
Frankly, I’m tired of career politicians shutting working families out while they spar across the aisle and make cable news appearances. I’m tired of wealthy special interests pulling the (purse) strings every time Congress has to fund our government. I’m tired of the broken promises and bald-faced lies.
**That’s why I jumped in this race: to bring a new, outside perspective to the Senate and deliver the ground-level leadership Michiganders deserve.** Because amid all this talk about government shutdowns and warring parties, working folks are struggling to pay their bills and provide for their families, and I’m sick of it.
So I’m not running as a politician. I’m running as Hill — as a proud Michigander, single father, card-carrying union organizer, and small business owner who’s fed up with the gridlock that has kept our communities in a constant cycle of broken promises.
**[I’m not taking a dime of corporate PAC money, so I’m counting on your support to win this race for Michigan’s future. Will you chip in before my campaign’s midnight deadline to help me get it done? Every dollar is critical at this stage.](https://act.hillharper.com/go/476?t=5&akid=1023%2E62735%2EFHPDhT)**
**[DONATE NOW »](https://act.hillharper.com/go/476?t=6&akid=1023%2E62735%2EFHPDhT)**
Together, we rise. Let’s get after it, Peter.
Hill Harper

Dear Peter,
I have some exciting news to share with you: the Hawaii Office of Elections has confirmed that we have collected the required signatures to establish the “We The People” party in Hawaii, _with more than three times the required number of signatures submitted._
The “We The People” party will nominate me as its Presidential Candidate.
When I declared my independence from the two-party Washington establishment and announced my campaign for President, I knew it would be an all-out fight.
I knew the Democrat and Republican establishments would stop at nothing to try and block my campaign every step of the way.
_And I knew I couldn’t do any of this without friends like you. Thank you!_
As you know, I’m facing the biggest challenge to my campaign – I must get my name on the ballot in all 50 states and the District of Columbia, a process that will cost nearly $20 million.
The unwavering generosity of friends like you has been invaluable to my campaign.
[Now, as our filing deadline approaches tonight, I'm calling on you to stand behind our campaign and help us finish strong one more time.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=challenge_2_29_24_em2_nd3&n=5)

[CONTRIBUTE $24 >>](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?amount=24&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=challenge_2_29_24_em2_nd3&n=8)
[CONTRIBUTE $100 >> ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?amount=100&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=challenge_2_29_24_em2_nd3&n=9)
[CONTRIBUTE $240 >> ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?amount=240&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=challenge_2_29_24_em2_nd3&n=10)
[CONTRIBUTE OTHER AMOUNT >> ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=challenge_2_29_24_em2_nd3&n=11)
Your continued support will be a huge boost in our fight to get my name on every ballot – _including yours._
The good news is, we’ve qualified to be on the ballot in three states, including the recent addition of Hawaii along with Utah and New Hampshire.
However, our journey is far from over, and the challenges ahead are significant.
The process of securing ballot access as an independent presidential candidate is an uphill battle, unlike the easy path afforded to Democrat and Republican candidates. While they breeze through with minimal effort, we must gather over 1,000,000 petition signatures across the nation.
[Democracy encompasses so much more than simply casting a vote. It requires a collective effort to break free from the confines of a rigged system and empower the voices of "We The People."](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=challenge_2_29_24_em2_nd3&n=12)
This is a fight we must win! So, I humbly ask for your generous contribution.

Jill Lochner is a Republican primary challenger running to replace Elise Stefanik in 2024 for NY-21
| Meet the moderate Republican who wants to primary Rep. Stefanik **Poststar | By ****EMILY RUSSELL (ADIRONDACK REPORTER)** [Published Mar 28, 2023](https://jillforcongress.com/index.php?option=com_acym&ctrl=fronturl&task=click&urlid=59&userid=5597&mailid=73) Back when Elise Stefanik was first elected to represent the North Country in Congress in 2014, Jill Lochner said she liked what Stefanik stood for. "She presented herself as a moderate, more like myself," said Lochner, "but she's taken a turn and she's become increasingly far-right and ultra-MAGA since then." Stefanik is one of Donald Trump's most loyal supporters. Since she's made that shift, her standing in the Republican party has skyrocketed. As conference chair, Stefanik is now the third-ranking Republican in the house. Lochner has never been elected to public office. She's worked in special education and government consulting. Like Stefanik, Lochner now lives outside the 21st Congressional district, in the town of Greenfield just west of Saratoga Springs. Lochner is running partly because she's frustrated by Stefanik's rhetoric in recent years, which she describes as "hateful and divisive." "I think we need to get back to respectful conversation, debate, dialogue," said Lochner. "I also don't believe that being a Republican means I need to hate and constantly criticize Democrats." Republican Congresswoman Elise Stefanik declared victory at her election night party at the Queensbury Hotel in Nov. 2022. Photo: Emily Russell Lochner identifies as a moderate Republican. She believes in small government, fiscal responsibility and gun rights. She differs from Stefanik and most of the Republican party on one key issue- abortion. "I believe that the government should stay out of women's bodies and those choices should be made between a woman and her doctor," said Lochner. In order to get on the Republican primary ballot next summer, Lochner says she needs about 1,300 petition signatures. Stefanik hasn't been challenged in a primary since she first ran in 2014. Since then, she's defeated every Democrat by a double-digit margin and raises millions of dollars each election cycle.
[Read More](https://jillforcongress.com/index.php?option=com_acym&ctrl=fronturl&task=click&urlid=60&userid=5597&mailid=73)

Hochul signs new congressional maps into law **Spectrumlocalnews.com****| By Luke Parsnow & Jack Arpey** [Published Feb. 28, 2024 at 8:05 PM EST](https://jillforcongress.com/index.php?option=com_acym&ctrl=fronturl&task=click&urlid=61&userid=5597&mailid=73) New York Gov. Kathy Hochul has signed into law a new set of congressional maps approved Wednesday by the state Legislature after Democratic lawmakers on Monday rejected the newest proposed boundaries drawn by the state's Independent Redistricting Commission. Legislation introduced earlier this week that would make some changes to the maps the commission approved last week passed the state Senate and Assembly on Wednesday afternoon. Lawmakers' speed on the effort was made possible by Hochul's passage of a message of necessity Wednesday morning, which allows legislators to circumvent the three-day waiting period required before acting on bills. Hochul signed the maps into law hours after they passed the Legislature, her office said Wednesday evening, meaning they have now taken effect. [New NY-21 congressional map](https://jillforcongress.com/index.php?option=com_acym&ctrl=fronturl&task=click&urlid=62&userid=5597&mailid=73)
[Read More](https://jillforcongress.com/index.php?option=com_acym&ctrl=fronturl&task=click&urlid=63&userid=5597&mailid=73)
| Embarrassing low productivity of the 118th Congress under Elise Stefanik Under the leadership of Conference Chair Elise Stefanik, the current Congress has passed the fewest laws of any other congressional session in modern history, according to GovTrack statistics. [https://www.govtrack.us/congress/bills/statistics](https://jillforcongress.com/index.php?option=com_acym&ctrl=fronturl&task=click&urlid=64&userid=5597&mailid=73) This makes the 118th Congress on track to be the least productive since the Great Depression, with only 39 laws enacted last year. By comparison, most congressional sessions pass between 300 and 450 laws in both years in office. The 118th Congress has been marked with chaos and bitter political attacks. As House Conference Chair, Elise Stefanik's leadership has focused on embracing discord and divisiveness to the detriment of her constituents in NY-21. It's time for Congress to start working for the American people. We have real problems, and Elise Stefanik's leadership is failing us all. It's time to focus on righting the economy. It's time to address the Fentanyl epidemic that is front and center in the North Country. It's time to invest in rural economies, infrastructure, and opportunities. **GovTrack.us | Nbcnews.com** [Published Jan 22, 2024 at 7:00 AM EST](https://jillforcongress.com/index.php?option=com_acym&ctrl=fronturl&task=click&urlid=65&userid=5597&mailid=73) [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2024-election/s-embarrassing-republicans-worry-no-achievements-run-2024-rcna131902](https://jillforcongress.com/index.php?option=com_acym&ctrl=fronturl&task=click&urlid=66&userid=5597&mailid=73)

body:
Have you heard about KOOTH and is it in your local school? | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/a4934771066e/announcing-the-pioneer-pac-12682507?e=c50edee7be)
---
Friend,
I recently announced the formation of a new political action committee. One of the main reasons that I decided to create the Pioneer PAC is the safety of our children and parental rights and involvement in education.
Liberal politicians and organizations, led by the teachers’ unions have taken aim at not only taking away a parent’s right to know what their child is being taught, but also the right to know if their child has been bullied, their safety threatened, they are in possession of drugs or have mental health concerns.
The threat to our children’s safety and parental rights is real!
_**Have you heard about Kooth?**_
Kooth is a foreign company that offers mental health counseling to students in our local public schools, WITHOUT parental knowledge or consent.
_**How did this get started?**_
Former Governor Tom Wolf and the Pennsylvania Legislature provided Kooth with $3 million of our tax dollars to start a pilot program in our schools. Districts receive this money and can implement this program WITHOUT a vote by the school board.
On its own website, Kooth says that it cannot diagnose or treat mental health illnesses, yet it is offering an online mental health service to our children.
_**What is the problem?**_
There are no safety measures in place to prevent someone from lying about their age and school and creating a fake account.
I am not minimizing the mental health problem facing our country, and especially our children. Our schools need more help and support in this area, but strangers on the Internet talking to our children is not the answer.
Parents should decide whether their child will be allowed to participate in programs like Kooth and not be kept in the dark.
Earlier this week, in the Wyoming Area School District, students were gathered in the auditorium for a presentation done by Kooth representatives. During the program, our children were asked to go on Kooth’s website and create an account. Alarmingly, they were asked not to tell their parents about it. If they created the account, they were promised cookies.
_**What is going on?**_
Decisions regarding children’s health and safety should never be made without parental involvement or without community knowledge.

No one should be talking to our children or grandchildren without parents giving consent.

No politician should EVER think that they know better than you as the parent.
Do you agree? Let us know.
| [Yes, I agree!](mailto:info@thepioneerpac.com?subject=Yes!%20I%20agree%2C%20we%20must%20stop%20KOOTH!&body=)
---
Sincerely,
Lou BarlettaChairman, Pioneer PACFormer U.S. Congressman

Friend,

My career in public service began in 2016, when I was recruited to flip a competitive House seat blue. I was serving as the president of Nevada’s largest synagogue, and looking back now, that was incredibly fitting – **because my Jewish faith and values have always been at the very core of my work in Congress.**
In fact, my decision to run for public office was guided by the Jewish principle of Tikkun Olam _–_ _to leave the world a better place than how we found it._
I’m so proud of the progress we've made in the years since. And in the face of growing antisemitism, attacks on reproductive freedom, and threats to tear down our democracy, I'm as committed as ever to making positive change happen. **But** **I****need _your_ help.**

Playing politics with women’s bodies has gone way too far. If something as widely-supported as I.V.F. can be threatened, I shudder to think what else is possible with another Republican majority congress. subject: The Panhandle is on fire

body:
Here’s what I’m seeing on the ground | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/742022a4cfc4/a-new-way-forward-for-texas-12682721?e=b8ba94fd9b)
---
My plan for this week was to host more campaign events and do everything I could to get out the vote.
But, on Tuesday night after an event in Galveston, I received news that wildfires had spread across 500,000 acres of land in the Panhandle.
I couldn’t sit idly while the Panhandle deals with one of the worst disasters in Texas’ history.
**So Gloria and I filled the car with water and supplies and drove 9 hours that night from Houston to provide support. We arrived Wednesday morning in Borger ready to serve.**
[](https://tchenkofortexas.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=93f02de4b9a588e8269491419&id=15dc51d12e&e=b8ba94fd9b)
**The people I’m meeting and the stories I’m hearing are surreal. And painful.**_**But we’re finding ways to be helpful so I’m glad we came.**_
If you want to help support the communities affected by the fire, the Lubbock-Avalanche Journal did a roundup of ways to do your part. [**Here’s the article**](https://tchenkofortexas.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=93f02de4b9a588e8269491419&id=888f066beb&e=b8ba94fd9b)**.**
If you’re in the area and we can be of any assistance, let us know. Our number is 713-364-5889. We’re here to help.
Thank you and God Bless,Thierry TchenkoDemocratic Candidate for U.S. Senate

clean_body: | | | We have some very exciting news to share with you today, Peter: The official Working Families Party response to President Biden’s State of the Union Address will be delivered next Thursday, March 7th — by Nicolas O’Rourke! Nicolas is a pastor and a longtime organizer who made history last November when he and his running mate, Kendra Brooks, shut the Republican Party out of any at-large City Council seats in Philadelphia for the first time in more than half a century. We are thrilled to have him share what we’re fighting for this year, and how together, our movement can win. This is a must-watch, Peter. ** The speech will be broadcast in English and Spanish. In this year’s response, we’ll lay out a vision for working-class governance from city halls to Congress, and how, with a bold agenda of healthcare, housing, public safety, and peace, we can transform the status quo that has held this country back for too long. We’ll also lay out how we can block the MAGA movement from power while building governing power for working families in every city and in every corner of this country, to win the future we all deserve. From doing our part to end Republican control of Congress, defend and elect working families champions, win in the states, and block the authoritarian right — we have a lot of fights ahead of us this year, Peter. Are you ready to hear how we can win every single one of them, and build a country that works for the many, not just the few? In solidarity, Working Families Party Thoughts? Feedback? body:
#
In 2018, Alexandria made headlines when she beat all odds and became the youngest woman ever elected to Congress.
But it’s her unrelenting commitment to the progressive movement that elected her in the first place — fighting for bold climate action, Medicare for All, and real change for working families like her own — that has kept our values at the center of the national conversation.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240229-1.xW229Z&refcode=em20240229-5906-P_FND_EGR_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5906%2E2526796%2EqEQbiD)
**Now, she is officially running for a 4th term.** And with your help, Alexandria can operate independently from our corrupting system of campaign finance and revolving-door politics. **That's bad news for corporations and special interests enriching themselves from the status quo, but great news for everyday people.**
[Will you make a $5 donation today to Alexandria’s 2024 re-election campaign? Any amount makes a huge difference to keep a progressive champion in Congress fighting for us.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240229-1.xW229Z&refcode=em20240229-5906-P_FND_EGR_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=5906%2E2526796%2EqEQbiD)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240229-1.xW229Z&refcode=em20240229-5906-P_FND_EGR_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=5906%2E2526796%2EqEQbiD)**
We need to get Alexandria back to Congress so she can keep doing what she was elected to do: **demand better**.
Alexandria campaigned on expanding Medicare in order to make prescriptions more affordable. Now, Medicare has the power to negotiate prescription drugs — and insulin is capped at $35/ month. Alexandria’s Green New Deal was called pie-in-the-sky, but it laid the groundwork for Congress to pass its largest ever investment to fight climate change — $369 billion.
And because she takes no donations from corporations, lobbyists, or special interests, **Alexandria works only for us**.
[Please chip in any amount you can to AOC’s 2024 re-election fund today. Every dollar, no matter the amount, shows widespread support for our progressive priorities from NY-14 and beyond.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240229-1.xW229Z&refcode=em20240229-5906-P_FND_EGR_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=5906%2E2526796%2EqEQbiD)

Whether or not you can give today, thank you for standing with our movement.
With gratitude,
Team AOC

Hey. It’s Jane. There’s an old saying I think about often: If you want to go fast, go alone. If you want to go far, go together. I couldn’t agree with this more. That's why the Jane Fonda Climate PAC champions the power of unity in our fight against climate change. Our ability to elect climate champions depends on a lot of individuals supporting our work however they can. So the stronger our grassroots support, the stronger our impact. Our strategy is clear: We provide direct financial support to candidates who are committed to fighting the climate crisis. Our endorsed candidates refuse support from Big Oil and other corporate polluters, relying instead on building broad coalitions of supporters who share their vision for a clean and sustainable future. This stance means that the small-dollar donations we receive can go even further, amplifying our impact where it counts the most. Now, as February draws to a close, we find ourselves on the cusp of another end-of-month fundraising deadline. That's why the Jane Fonda Climate PAC champions the power of unity in our fight against climate change. Our ability to elect climate champions depends on a lot of individuals supporting our work however they can. So the stronger our grassroots support, the stronger our impact. Our strategy is clear: We provide direct financial support to candidates who are committed to fighting the climate crisis. Our endorsed candidates refuse support from Big Oil and other corporate polluters, relying instead on building broad coalitions of supporters who share their vision for a clean and sustainable future. This stance means that the small-dollar donations we receive can go even further, amplifying our impact where it counts the most. Now, as February draws to a close, we find ourselves on the cusp of another end-of-month fundraising deadline. Friends,
Earlier this week, Louisiana became the 28th state to pass Constitutional Carry!
The state legislature originally passed a Con Carry bill in 2021, but it was vetoed by then Democrat Governor John Bel Edwards. Republicans had the votes to override his veto, but Edwards was able to sustain it by making deals with the RINOs in the legislature.
With conservative Jeff Landry now in the governor's mansion, the Louisiana Freedom Caucus (LAFC) understood that this was the time to get Constitutional Carry over the finish line was now.
LAFC founding member State Senator Blake Miguez wrote a clean Constitutional Carry bill during this week's special session. And LAFC founding member Rep. Danny McCormick has been preparing the soil for years by sponsoring it in the State House. It passed overwhelmingly in both chambers, despite vocal opposition from the Democrats. The bill now heads to Gov. Landry's desk.
And to put a patriotic cherry on top, once he signs it, the law will take effect on the 4th of July.
[Read more about it on the LA Freedom Caucus's own Substack.](https://substack.com/redirect/f4d04454-364e-4607-a474-8eedcc24caa1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**South Carolina**
In the Palmetto State, the SC Freedom Caucus was able to successfully block RINOs from moving a watered down Constitutional Carry bill through the legislature, even when pressured by the National Rifle Association to support it.
The State Senate passed a version of the bill that contained several anti-gun amendments to the point where you couldn't even consider it a Constitutional Carry bill anymore.
In fact, the amendments specifically increased criminal penalties for citizens carrying without a permit while _**exempting politicians**_. "Rights for me, but not for thee". So hypocritical.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ae523d00-da5c-4a65-bd5c-7097e774dfaf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Read more about the State Senate's changes to the bill [here](https://substack.com/redirect/55562f4f-eef9-43f8-beaf-9f995ae0c6ca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
The good news is that after alerting the grassroots, the South Carolina Freedom Caucus was able to convince House leadership to reject the proposed changes to the bill made by the Senate and support only clean Constitutional Carry legislation. The bill now goes to a conference committee where the RINO Senators will be put in a tough spot.
Stay tuned!
**Wyoming**
In another victory for the 2nd Amendment and school safety, a bill in Wyoming to do away with the ridiculous concept of "gun free zones" passed overwhelmingly in the House.
The bill was sponsored by Wyoming Freedom Caucus Vice Chair Rep. Jeremy Haroldson. Much like South Carolina, the WYFC also had to kill several RINO-proposed amendments to water down the bill.
It now heads to the State Senate where it stands a great chance of passing.
[Read more in the Cowboy State Daily.](https://substack.com/redirect/84dc1620-68ef-4727-923a-4047cd54af88?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Americans' 2nd Amendment rights are non-negotiable and our state Freedom Caucus members understand this more than anybody.

State Freedom Caucuses deliver victories on the 2nd Amendment | | | Feb 29 | | | | | | | | Friends, Earlier this week, Louisiana became the 28th state to pass Constitutional Carry! The state legislature originally passed a Con Carry bill in 2021, but it was vetoed by then Democrat Governor John Bel Edwards. Republicans had the votes to override his veto, but Edwards was able to sustain it by making deals with the RINOs in the legislature. With conservative Jeff Landry now in the governor's mansion, the Louisiana Freedom Caucus (LAFC) understood that this was the time to get Constitutional Carry over the finish line was now. LAFC founding member State Senator Blake Miguez wrote a clean Constitutional Carry bill during this week's special session. And LAFC founding member Rep. Danny McCormick has been preparing the soil for years by sponsoring it in the State House. It passed overwhelmingly in both chambers, despite vocal opposition from the Democrats. The bill now heads to Gov. Landry's desk. And to put a patriotic cherry on top, once he signs it, the law will take effect on the 4th of July. South Carolina In the Palmetto State, the SC Freedom Caucus was able to successfully block RINOs from moving a watered down Constitutional Carry bill through the legislature, even when pressured by the National Rifle Association to support it. The State Senate passed a version of the bill that contained several anti-gun amendments to the point where you couldn't even consider it a Constitutional Carry bill anymore. In fact, the amendments specifically increased criminal penalties for citizens carrying without a permit while exempting politicians. "Rights for me, but not for thee". So hypocritical. | | ---|---|--- Read more about the State Senate's changes to the bill . The good news is that after alerting the grassroots, the South Carolina Freedom Caucus was able to convince House leadership to reject the proposed changes to the bill made by the Senate and support only clean Constitutional Carry legislation. The bill now goes to a conference committee where the RINO Senators will be put in a tough spot. Stay tuned! Wyoming In another victory for the 2nd Amendment and school safety, a bill in Wyoming to do away with the ridiculous concept of "gun free zones" passed overwhelmingly in the House. The bill was sponsored by Wyoming Freedom Caucus Vice Chair Rep. Jeremy Haroldson. Much like South Carolina, the WYFC also had to kill several RINO-proposed amendments to water down the bill. It now heads to the State Senate where it stands a great chance of passing. Americans' 2nd Amendment rights are non-negotiable and our state Freedom Caucus members understand this more than anybody. # Urgent: Help Us Secure Victory in the May 14th Primary! 🇺🇸
Dear Fellow Republican,
As a valued member of the Republican family, we are reaching out to you today with an urgent plea for support. The Roca for Congress campaign is at a critical juncture, and we need your help to secure victory in the upcoming primary election on May 14th for Maryland’s 6th Congressional District.
With absentee ballots set to be mailed out by the state of Maryland starting on March 29th, we are facing a tight deadline to ensure our message reaches every voter in our district. To make this happen, we must raise $20,000 by March 15th in order to get our materials out in time.
Your contribution today will play a crucial role in funding our outreach efforts, including mailers, text messages, phone calls, and postcards. These channels are vital in engaging voters and highlighting the principles that our Republican candidate, Mariela Roca, stands for.
Here's how your support can make a difference:
1. **Mailers** : By investing in mailers, we can deliver a tangible and persuasive message directly to voters' mailboxes, ensuring they are well-informed about our Mariela’s vision for our community.
2. **Text Campaigns** : Mobile communication is key in reaching a diverse audience. Your contribution will help us implement a robust text messaging campaign to connect with voters on a personal level and address their concerns.
3. **Phone Calls** : Personalized phone calls remain one of the most effective ways to engage voters. Your support will enable us to make targeted calls, sharing our candidate's platform and answering questions directly.
4. **Postcards** : Postcards offer a personal touch, allowing us to reach voters in a memorable and impactful way. Your contribution will help us design and distribute postcards that resonate with voters and reinforce Mariela’s message.

We understand that these are challenging times, but the future of our district and country is at stake.
Every dollar you contribute will bring us one step closer to ensuring a Republican victory in November for Maryland 6th, one of the most crucial races in the country that can decide our House Majortiy!
Please click on the link below to make your secure contribution:
[**rocaforcongress.com/donate**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=8382d620e5&e=0a12281e0e)
Thank you for standing with us in this pivotal moment.
Let's not forget the bigger picture: the future of our Republican majority in the House of Representatives hangs in the balance. We cannot afford to lose sight of the importance of securing seats like Maryland's 6th Congressional District if we want to keep a Republican majority in the House of Representatives and continue advancing our conservative agenda.
Sincerely,
MichaelCampaign Fundraising ChairRoca for Congress Campaign
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=e02b8a71c1&e=0a12281e0e)
|

# More about Mariela Roca
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=f3d399ff02&e=0a12281e0e)
My name is Mariela Roca. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for Congress here in Maryland’s 6th Congressional District.
[**Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution to help boost my campaign’s momentum and WIN BACK Maryland’s 6th Congressional District!**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=da25cfc351&e=0a12281e0e)
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=f7459e0826&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for Congress because I was raised by a single mom in Puerto Rico who always showed me how hard work and determination is what makes us all live the American dream. I learned english when I was 5 years old, and from that young age always felt so proud to be an American.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=ade832324a&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for Congress as a military veteran. I began my journey of service to our nation in 2005 when I joined the U.S. Air Force at the age of 20. During my military service I had the honor of serving my county abroad in the Global War on Terror, serving within the Task Force Medical and the Bagram Theater Internment Facility (BTIF) in Bagram, Afghanistan, during Operation Enduring Freedom in 2007. I know what sacrifice looks like - and this is why I love my country so much.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=e6e51593c5&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for my kids, your kids, and your grandkids. Everything that I do in my life is to make the best possible future for my daughter and my son and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has offered me my entire life.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=91b05a1586&e=0a12281e0e)
[**I’M RUNNING FOR CONGRESS BECAUSE WE HAVE A COUNTRY TO SAVE!**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=0b8fc07b9d&e=0a12281e0e)
Even during our most challenging moments, we are fortunate to call America our home. But it's clear that under the Biden administration, we face significant challenges, our prospects are dwindling, we are weak on the world stage, our economy is failing, and American families are being left behind every single day.
[**I’m running for Congress because America can do better with leaders that will always fight for America first. No matter what.**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=c5e45e2166&e=0a12281e0e)
**As a military veteran** , I intimately understand the profound significance of service and the willingness to make the ultimate sacrifice for my country. My time in the military taught me the unwavering commitment to duty, honor, and the defense of freedom. It's a bond that transcends words; a deep-seated connection with the men and women I served alongside, many of whom paid the ultimate price. I've witnessed the selflessness, courage, and dedication that define the character of those who choose to protect their nation.
**As a medical logistician** , my mission was to ensure that our dedicated warfighters had the essential tools and supplies required to save lives on the frontlines. I understood the critical nature of my role in providing our troops with the medical resources and equipment they needed to deliver immediate care in challenging and high-stress situations. I am now prepared to take the knowledge, commitment, and understanding I gained in that role with me to Congress, where I will tirelessly advocate for policies that will support our country, military and American families first. Above anything.
**As a** **mother** , I understand firsthand the deep commitment and love that comes with the responsibility of providing for one's family. In the countless roles we take on as parents - caregiver, protector, educator, and provider - we become intimately acquainted with the challenges and triumphs of family life. We witness the struggles that many families face, whether it's making ends meet, securing access to quality education, or ensuring our children have the healthcare they need. It's in these moments that we are inspired to take action, to advocate for better opportunities, and to fight for a brighter future for our families.
I know how to make our community, district, and America strong and proud because i’ve done it before.
[**And i’ll do it again as your next Congresswoman.**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=562dcfe1af&e=0a12281e0e)
As your next Congresswoman for Maryland’s 6th Congressional District I will always fight for policies that will revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s out of control spending, champion school choice & parental rights, and save America’s future.
But, in order to do this, I need your support today so I can spread this message to everyone across our district and country.
[**Will you chip in today to help me win this fight for our nation’s future?**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=a832bb16d5&e=0a12281e0e)
Together we WILL flip Maryland’s 6th Congressional District for Republicans and make America strong and proud again.
Sincerely,
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=924dae21a4&e=0a12281e0e)
Mariela RocaRepublican Candidate for CongressMaryland’s 6th District
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=bb6d4ac2e6&e=0a12281e0e)

I’m running for Congress because I was raised by a single mom in Puerto Rico who always showed me how hard work and determination is what makes us all live the American dream. I learned english when I was 5 years old, and from that young age always felt so proud to be an American. I’m running for Congress as a military veteran. I began my journey of service to our nation in 2005 when I joined the U.S. Air Force at the age of 20. During my military service I had the honor of serving my county abroad in the Global War on Terror, serving within the Task Force Medical and the Bagram Theater Internment Facility (BTIF) in Bagram, Afghanistan, during Operation Enduring Freedom in 2007. I know what sacrifice looks like - and this is why I love my country so much. I’m running for my kids, your kids, and your grandkids. Everything that I do in my life is to make the best possible future for my daughter and my son and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has offered me my entire life. Even during our most challenging moments, we are fortunate to call America our home. But it's clear that under the Biden administration, we face significant challenges, our prospects are dwindling, we are weak on the world stage, our economy is failing, and American families are being left behind every single day. As a military veteran , I intimately understand the profound significance of service and the willingness to make the ultimate sacrifice for my country. My time in the military taught me the unwavering commitment to duty, honor, and the defense of freedom. It's a bond that transcends words; a deep-seated connection with the men and women I served alongside, many of whom paid the ultimate price. I've witnessed the selflessness, courage, and dedication that define the character of those who choose to protect their nation. As a medical logistician , my mission was to ensure that our dedicated warfighters had the essential tools and supplies required to save lives on the frontlines. I understood the critical nature of my role in providing our troops with the medical resources and equipment they needed to deliver immediate care in challenging and high-stress situations. I am now prepared to take the knowledge, commitment, and understanding I gained in that role with me to Congress, where I will tirelessly advocate for policies that will support our country, military and American families first. Above anything. As a mother , I understand firsthand the deep commitment and love that comes with the responsibility of providing for one's family. In the countless roles we take on as parents - caregiver, protector, educator, and provider - we become intimately acquainted with the challenges and triumphs of family life. We witness the struggles that many families face, whether it's making ends meet, securing access to quality education, or ensuring our children have the healthcare they need. It's in these moments that we are inspired to take action, to advocate for better opportunities, and to fight for a brighter future for our families. I know how to make our community, district, and America strong and proud because i’ve done it before. As your next Congresswoman for Maryland’s 6th Congressional District I will always fight for policies that will revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s out of control spending, champion school choice & parental rights, and save America’s future. But, in order to do this, I need your support today so I can spread this message to everyone across our district and country. Together we WILL flip Maryland’s 6th Congressional District for Republicans and make America strong and proud again. Sincerely, Mariela RocaRepublican Candidate for CongressMaryland’s 6th District | | | | | | | ---|---|--- | | | Copyright (C) 2024 Roca for Congress. All rights reserved.

body:
With just a few hours to go until our February fundraising deadline, we’re about $80,000 from where we need to be to hit our goal.
#

Peter — it’s Ruben here. Wish I was coming to you with better news.
With just a few hours to go until our February fundraising deadline, we’re about $80,000 from where we need to be to hit our goal.
That’s a lot... no doubt. I know asking you to chip in $5 might not seem like the best way to close the gap to our goal.
But look: If 16,000 people chip in that $5 to this email, we’d hit it. And way more than 16,000 people are going to open this email. It’s just a matter of whether or not YOU can step up and make that donation. With you and lots of others chipping in, it all adds up.
So, it’s time to punch it. We gotta hit the gas here, or we’re at serious risk of missing this goal. And we have to hit it — with Kari Lake gaining steam, with Kyrsten Sinema getting ready to make her decision, and with countless outside groups getting ready to pour millions of dollars into attack ads, we just can’t miss.
So, please:

For generations, Black women have been at the very forefront of social change in America, yet our country still has a long way to go when it comes to equal representation in politics.

**Today is the last day of Black History Month, but I am keenly aware all year long of the need for more Black women in elected office.** We cannot have representation without a government that reflects the people it serves.

That's why I'm proud to highlight the EMILYs List-endorsed Black women running for the House and Senate this cycle. Today is the last day of Black History Month, but I am keenly aware all year long of the need for more Black women in elected office. We cannot have representation without a government that reflects the people it serves. That's why I'm proud to highlight the EMILYs List-endorsed Black women running for the House and Senate this cycle. I'm confident that each and every one of these women can not only hold and flip seats, but also ensure that we have better representation in Congress — because when we elect Black women, we build a better future for everyone. = Women of color face barriers to running for office that others do not — particularly when it comes to fundraising. In 2018, Black women running for office raised 55% less than white women. That's where the EMILYs List community comes in. ---
Friend, One of the most important findings of the 1945-46 International Military Tribunal that tried Nazi war criminals and their collaborators for crimes against humanity was that _**all**_ those in Nazi Germany with policy-making authority were responsible for the monstrous crimes, including genocide, perpetrated by the Hitler regime. Often, Nuremberg defendants sought to answer the charges against them by saying that they hadn't known what was going on, but Justice Robert Jackson of New York State, insisted they _were_ in fact guilty, by way of the conspiracy in which they had participated. "These are rules which every society has found necessary in order to reach men, like these defendants, who never get blood on their hands, but who lay plans that result in the shedding of blood...." In other words, **_they knew, or should have known, the consequences_** of their policies and their actions. Were such standards applied today, scores American and other government officials, including President Biden, British Prime Minister Rishi Sunak, French President Macron, NY Senators Schumer and Gillibrand, and probably hundreds of others, would be found guilty of the crime of genocide being carried out in Gaza as detailed in the South African case brought before International Court of Justice last December. This symposium is dedicated to remembering history, so as not to repeat its crimes, and to remember why justice must be served.

[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1ce50cdeb45f423485415c494233fae0&_e=AKIWZmf3Yio8bpYqXHPjR6nN3fyPHaT_93Bjf0VsFziFIlvPkN1jOr2j0wnW08dte2Dn6hKwbz_-485yz9HcXviaS4mDoBw4WQubqI4PDcRNMEa-0hynTIEbEqe9GKfp9PAQWGpVS9NhYMKlG-gr7pGoS_lymsNBpYUi7YaypIqOVPUrL9hu2DKCDW11C0hqF1t2lcQmhXwsgJYeUCJqPvk6vc3RQGmRxkfnK-_BeG3JpgSAd1L-CaCOwFv2rdpob3cjX_1nmDNmHJot9M_VS57ifp9YzUVEHXwtoNhfOlfyteAT02URXSD66FOir1ZI_s3zmVCuG2cUKoiDnYctTvq_el280XU-1LNPiPnsAS3qybImL6cdYSwcPZy22dhmCR0cAbXmUlz_0Ng0utTCzv4-Taz734oxQ2oirnUwu9s%3D)

Dear Friend,

You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.**

The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...

Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.
Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.
The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in "extremist ideologies" and having the potential for "domestic terrorism."
Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.**

By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty.

Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below:

[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1ce50cdeb45f423485415c494233fae0&_e=AKIWZmf3Yio8bpYqXHPjR6nN3fyPHaT_93Bjf0VsFziFIlvPkN1jOr2j0wnW08dte2Dn6hKwbz_-485yz9HcXviaS4mDoBw4WQubqI4PDcRNMEa-0hynTIEbEqe9GKfp9PAQWGpVS9NhYMKlG-gr7pGoS_lymsNBpYUi7YaypIqOVPUrL9hu2DKCDW11C0hqF1t2lcQmhXwsgJYeUCJqPvk6vc3RQGmRxkfnK-_BeG3JpgSAd1L-CaCOwFv2rdpob3cjX_1nmDNmHJot9M_VS_C0EJ5SB0ZlpGzjnpOu0v4FowBdXQvjsFmLKNNKIWGfzJfSVNDzaK8uhqN9yFkMzWl59OGgTCcQGiVTMtQV96NtpzCElB3YS34bfJUrOFHE0loLSTUzobxeh7pn1Q74Q7fDLt758vGNyRw46xgOzhE%3D)

Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."**

Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion."

These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties.

You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course.

**The first step is ...EDUCATION.**

Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities.

That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty.

We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.**

These efforts include:

name: Gene Karpinski, LCV
subject: [MEMBERSHIP DEADLINE] Peter, we haven't heard from you yet. Renew your LCV membership before midnight:
body:
Time sensitive

Peter - our Membership Drive deadline is a few days away, and we're reaching out because we haven't heard from you yet (renew your membership here and your contribution will be tripled https://links.messages.lcv. ).

The truth is your membership matters, and it's particularly critical right now.

Here's the situation: Earlier this month, Senator Joe Manchin backed away from a climate deal after months of negotiations, choosing to side with Big Oil and Republicans. It leaves the deal one vote short -- stalling any real action in Congress for now.

In response, we're redoubling our efforts on pushing the White House to act decisively on climate. The Biden administration has massive amounts of power to curb climate pollution - but that will only happen if the environmental movement makes it happen.

Right now, we're facing a critical test: the Biden administration is weighing a plan to block all new oil and gas drilling leases on public waters.

This could be huge -- and a decision is coming. Right now, we're organizing volunteers from all over the country to flood the administration with letters, pressuring Biden to hold to his promises.

Peter -- it's your membership support that makes victory possible here. But we have to do more. A group of donors has put together a fund to triple match every contribution before Sunday's membership deadline:

Can we count on your support? Claim your membership now - it only takes $5 >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/ebDKc9Pd9-

The ban on new oil and gas leases is the first of many huge environmental decisions, Peter. And right now, we're pushing for serious action on so many fronts -- including:
Setting tight standards for power plants and other major emitters of climate pollution
Placing strict limits on air pollution to safeguard all communities Expediting requirements of 100% tailpipe pollution-free new cars by 2035 and trucks by 2040
Protecting communities from hazardous and super-polluting methane Conserving 30% of our public lands and waters by 2030 Declaring a climate emergency - and so much more. The best way you can help win each and every one of these fights right now is to claim your LCV membership - all it takes is a gift of $5 or more. https://links.messages.lcv.

Thank you, thank you, thank you, Peter. This is such a critical moment for the environment, and we're so fortunate to have you on the team.

Onward,

Gene Karpinski
President
League of Conservation Voters
